848b19b8.title: Solution Architect_Supply planning (D396)
848b19b8.description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect**
with
**10+ years of industry experience, including a minimum of 3 years of hands-on o9 Solutions implementation experience**
. The candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable o9 solutions, collaborating closely with clients and cross-functional teams, and guiding the implementation team throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Client Requirement Management: Discuss, understand, validate, and finalize high-level business and functional requirements with clients.
* Solution Blueprinting: Lead and support blueprinting sessions to understand business processes, identify gaps, and define the appropriate o9 solution approach.
* Solution Design: Translate business requirements into high-level solution designs aligned with o9 capabilities, industry best practices, and client objectives.
* Requirement Breakdown: Break down high-level requirements into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria for development.
* Development Team Guidance: Provide architectural and functional guidance to the build team during user story development, ensuring the solution is aligned with the approved design.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, developers, project managers, and other technical teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
* UAT Support: Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), support issue resolution, validate delivered functionality, and ensure the solution meets agreed business requirements.
* User Training: Support and participate in user training, helping business users understand the implemented solution and its key functionalities.
* Solution Governance: Ensure consistency between business requirements, solution design, development, testing, and final implementation.

****Required Experience & Skills****

* 10+ years of overall industry experience.
* Minimum 3 years of o9 Solutions implementation experience.
* Strong understanding of o9 Solutions platform and supply chain planning processes.
* Experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience in requirements gathering, solution design, blueprinting, and user story creation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into actionable functional and technical requirements.
* Experience guiding development/build teams in an implementation environment.
* Hands-on experience supporting UAT, defect resolution, and user training.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a client-facing and cross-functional environment.

****Preferred Background****

* Experience in Supply Chain Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, Inventory Planning, or related areas.
* Experience delivering end-to-end o9 implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of implementation methodologies, solution governance, and best practices.

87a50f79.title: Solution Architect
87a50f79.description:
The Solution Architect is responsible for the design, integrity and quality of the SAP solution and of associated IS services delivered to Business, Support Functions and IS Technology domains as the case may be. Responsible that the SAP solution/service provides the required functionality and meets the requirement of business. Collaborates with and contributes to project set-up and delivery as well as to service operations optimization.
  
  
The Solution Architect is accountable for managing workstream interdependencies mainly but not restricted to the specific End-to-End Stream.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Defines the technical SAP solution/ E- Invoicing and ensures alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration across solution architects.
* Supports validation and prioritization of incoming business demand in collaboration with Project owners, business function and unit as well with the relevant IS Business Analyst, IS Service Manager, IS Application Manager and/or Global IS Domain Architect.
* Be responsible for translating the functional design into functional and technical specifications, review and sign off the functional and technical use case specifications.
* Communicate the technical specifications to the developers. Joining unit testing and support on UAT testing and defect resolution. Managing the transport request and it's status update until release to Production system.
* Formulate rules, principles and guidelines to guide the development of the technical solutions. Determine non-functional requirements and ensure service/ solution operation standards are considered accordingly. Keeps knowledge up to date regarding new and emerging IS technology and IS industry practices, bringing learning into HE; all within in the scope of the relevant IS solutions.
* Collaborates with users in projects and problem management to maintain, develop and deploy the best feasible and most- cost efficient IS solutions/services for the business. Ensures solution documentation and training material are well maintained and created.
* Consults, gives advice and supports the installation of new E - Invoicing solutions/services, or the changing of existing solutions/services. Consults the users to identify and learn about current procedures and to clarify further requirements.
* Supports the installation, management, maintenance, and optimization of all E- Invoicing processes related to the area of responsibility. Provides guidance to IS project management and IS delivery unit team in how to utilize IS application/solution standards (e.g. SAP) effectively.
* Commits and contributes to common result oriented collaboration with the various business processes IS architectural domains as well as the various enterprise technology IS architecture domains. For assigned tasks, executes all actions in IS processes according to agreed RACIS specification.
* In concert with the Global IS Domain Architect ensures that IS solution/service-related standards are considered accordingly. Provides support to temporary work teams, guiding and monitoring task completion, sharing expert knowledge and advice with/without carrying line responsibility.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer science (preferred) or related discipline.
* 5+ years of experience within Information Technology industry with solution architecture experience across various IT areas with focus in the areas of S/4 HANA system with E - Invoicing
* Practical implementation experience with integration software/tools: BizTalk and/or MuleSoft.
* International work experience in different countries/ cultures.
* Proven experience implementing SAP best practices, especially for smooth transition for carving out a business division from current SAP landscape to a different one.
* Highly adept at bridging, translating and integrating business with IT, and converting business requirements into IT solutions. Ability to provide leadership to ensure effective solutions that drive business value are created and implemented, in an environment of virtual teams.
* Awareness of latest technology, developments and offerings from SAP and their future direction. Able to sort through complex issues and make timely decisions. Ability to generate new ideas, challenge status quo, take risks, support change and foster innovation.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

96c4a6e8.title: GDS Consulting - Microsoft 365 Solution Architect - Manager
96c4a6e8.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Microsoft 365 solution architecture**
**/ Technical manager 1-2**
–
**Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting – Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Architect with a strong background in building and modernizing enterprise collaboration and content solutions. The role sits within the Enterprise Content and Modern Work practice, delivering integrated, compliant, and scalable solutions to clients across multiple regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for professionals with deep expertise in Microsoft 365 solution architecture, custom development, and integration to join our Digital Engineering Consulting team. This role offers the opportunity to work with a leading global organization, contribute to complex transformation and modernization initiatives, and play a key role in shaping and growing our modern workplace and integration service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
* Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
* Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
* Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
* Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
* Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 7–12 years of experience in enterprise solution architecture and development
* Strong hands-on experience with:

+ SharePoint Framework (SPFx)
+ Microsoft Teams app development
+ .NET / C#
+ REST APIs and integration patterns

* Proven experience designing enterprise-grade M365 solutions
* Strong understanding of modern workplace concepts (collaboration, productivity, extensibility)
* Excellent architectural thinking beyond platform-specific constraints
* Experience designing integrated solutions across multiple systems
* Strong understanding of cloud-native and modern application architectures
* Ability to define standards, patterns, and best practices

**Core Skills:**

* Microsoft 365 & SharePoint: SPFx development, PnP Framework, PowerShell automation
* Application Development: .NET, C#, React, Azure Functions, enterprise-grade solution design
* Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents with governance awareness
* Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, security, and integration with Power Platform and custom apps
* Integration Architecture: REST & SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, secure enterprise integrations
* Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control

**Desirable Skills:**

* Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
* Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
* AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
* Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
* Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
* PCF Controls: Custom PowerApps Component Framework development using React and TypeScript

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* Strong experience across Microsoft SharePoint (on‑premises and online), with the ability to modernize and extend solutions beyond platform constraints
* Proven hands-on expertise with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps, and Power Automate for building modern, extensible business solutions
* Strong front-end development skills using TypeScript, React, Angular, and Fluent UI, with an emphasis on scalable and reusable components
* Solid experience with PowerShell and PnP for automation, provisioning, and enterprise governance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to operate as a solution architect and trusted advisor

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**About EY**
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.
  
  
**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**
**Join us in building a better working world.**
**Apply now**
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

c811a1a9.title: Senior Solution Architect – Global DTC Technology
c811a1a9.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to support end-to-end architecture across PUMA’s global DTC technology landscape. In this role, you will ensure scalable, stable, and future-proof architecture decisions across digital and physical touchpoints. You will advise and enable Product and Project Teams by aligning business strategy, product roadmaps, and technology architecture, while ensuring high solution quality, strong non-functional standards, and sustainable platform evolution. Acting as an architectural authority for strategic initiatives, you will help guide the structured evolution and expansion of PUMA’s global technology ecosystem.
  
  
**Role:**

* Support with end-to-end solution architecture across the global DTC technology landscape
* Ensure scalable, stable, and future-proof architecture decisions across digital and physical touchpoints
* Advise and enables PUMA’s Product and Project Teams
* Alignment between business strategy, product roadmaps, and technology architecture, while governing solution quality, non-functional requirements, and long-term platform evolution.
* Enable structured evolution and expansion of the technology stack

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and own end-to-end solution architectures for strategic initiatives across digital channels, retail systems, core platforms, integrations, and data.
* Define architecture artifacts such as high-level architecture diagrams, design documents, data models, and system interaction maps.
* Define integration patterns (API-first, event-driven, modular, cloud-native architectures).
* Define and validate non-functional requirements including performance, security, scalability, compliance, resilience, and failure handling.
* Participate in discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and impact assessments.
* Advise squads, lead design reviews, and document key architecture decisions.
* Contribute to architecture governance and technology evaluations.
* Ensure architectural consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
* Collaborate with Platform, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure operational readiness, scalability, and reliable platform operations.
* Act as key interface between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Platform teams, and Management.
* Ensure adherence to security standards, data privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance.

**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**

* 8+ years of experience in solution or system architecture within complex IT environments
* Experience in DTC, eCommerce, retail, or omnichannel environments
* Strong understanding of integration architectures and modern engineering practices
* Experience working in global matrix organizations
* Strong communicator bridging business and engineering teams
* Structured, pragmatic, decision-oriented, and governance-aware working style

**Technology Scope**
Strong understanding of:
  
  

* Microservices and distributed systems
* Digital channels (web, app, commerce capabilities)
* Retail and store systems (POS, omnichannel integrations)
* Core platforms (order management, payments, CRM, data platforms)
* Integration layer (APIs, event-driven architectures, middleware)
* Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, and release management
* Observability and operational architecture principles
* Security concepts (OAuth2, SSO, CIAM).

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

**Description**
Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real-world healthcare challenges, and launching data-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Requirements**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
  
  
15+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
  
  
Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
  
  
Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
  
  
Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C++, JAVA, C#, etc)
  
  
Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
  
  
Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
  
  
Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
  
  
English proficiency at Advanced level.
  
  
Good presentation and demonstration skills
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
  
  
Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
  
  
Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
  
  
Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility & value.
  
  
Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
  
  
Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
  
  
Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
  
  
Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
  
  
Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

* Support post-migration stabilisation and optimisation phases.
* Track technical actions for migration waves and project milestones.

* Perform user/group sync checks and RBAC configuration.

**Operational Readiness & Handover**

* Create SOPs and runbooks for steady-state environments.
* Participate in knowledge-transfer sessions with managed services teams.
* Ensure governance, tagging, and security standards are implemented before handover.

* 5+ years in cloud or infrastructure delivery roles.

* Proven involvement in migration or transformation projects.
* Working knowledge of:

+ Azure Compute, Storage, Networking

* Basic automation/scripting exposure.
* Experience working in professional services / project-based delivery environments.

* Comfortable working with project plans and milestones.

* Ability to follow architecture designs and escalate risks early.

41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview**
Foundational Data & Model Services sits in Data & AI Foundations, inside Business & Market Insights. We own the data that B&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
  
  
About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
  
  
The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
  
  
Role
  
  
You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
  
  
Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
  
  
Run the migration off Hadoop and on-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
  
  
Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
  
  
Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
  
  
Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
  
  
Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
  
  
Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
  
  
**All About You**
We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
  
  
Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
  
  
Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
  
  
Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
  
  
Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
  
  
Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
  
  
A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow-through rather than mandate.
  
  
Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Program Manager**
to lead complex, cross-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the
**ServiceNow platform**
capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving strategic program planning, execution governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives within the ServiceNow capability.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong program leadership, business acumen, technical understanding, and executive communication skills to ensure programs deliver measurable value, remain aligned with organizational priorities, and meet quality, compliance, security, and operational expectations.
  
  
**Experience Range:**
16+ years
  
  
**Role Level:**
Senior Program Manager
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Program Strategy & Delivery
  
  

* Lead end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale technology programs from initiation through delivery and operational transition.
* Define program scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple projects, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and enterprise standards.

Governance, Risk & Controls
  
  

* Establish and manage program governance forums, decision frameworks, escalation paths, and executive reporting rhythms.
* Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, information security, change management, and operational readiness requirements.
* Maintain high-quality program documentation, status reporting, and evidence required for governance and control processes.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication
  
  

* Partner with senior business leaders, product owners, architects, engineering leaders, operations teams, finance partners, and external vendors.
* Prepare and deliver executive-ready updates covering program health, key decisions, risks, dependencies, financials, and business outcomes.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and ensure clear ownership of decisions and actions.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, planning workshops, and cross-functional working sessions.

Agile & Delivery Management
  
  

* Drive Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery practices across teams and programs.
* Monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, milestones, burn-up/burn-down trends, impediments, and release readiness.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and facilitate timely resolution of delivery blockers.
* Promote continuous improvement in planning, estimation, delivery predictability, and team operating practices.

Financial, Vendor & Resource Management
  
  

* Manage program budgets, forecasts, cost tracking, resource plans, and financial reporting in partnership with finance and leadership teams.
* Oversee vendor delivery performance, contract dependencies, and third-party commitments where applicable.
* Support capacity planning, prioritization, and trade-off decisions across program workstreams.
* Track program value realization, benefits, and measurable business outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in program management, project management, technology delivery, or related roles.
* Proven experience leading complex technology programs across multiple teams, geographies, or business functions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release management, change management, and technology operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, dependencies, risks, executive communications, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for executive audiences.
* Knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, GRC, Security Operations and similar processes and procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certification.
* Experience in enterprise applications, digital transformation, financial services technology, regulatory programs, or platform modernization.
* Experience managing vendor partners, statements of work, managed services, or third-party delivery models.
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, production support, observability, and operational resilience practices.
* Experience preparing executive dashboards, steering committee materials, and board-level or senior leadership updates.

**Technical Skills**

* Agile / Scrum / Kanban / SAFe delivery practices
* Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Clarity, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint
* SDLC, Release Management, Change Management, DevOps, CI/CD
* Program governance, portfolio reporting, and executive dashboards
* Risk, issue, dependency, and decision management
* Budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, and resource management
* Vendor management, SOW tracking, and third-party delivery oversight
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Ecosystem will be a significant plus.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
* Leadership, influence, and cross-functional collaboration
* Executive communication and presentation skills
* Financial and commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management and expectation setting
* Decision making and problem solving
* Conflict resolution and negotiation
* Delivery discipline, ownership, and accountability
* Coaching, mentoring, and continuous improvement orientation

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

c686670e.title: Software Architect
c686670e.description:
At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. Learn more at www.verint.com .

**Overview of Job Function:**

As a Software Architect for the WFM/PM platform in India, you will define the technical blueprint for how Verint's engineering team builds, scales, and evolves its Java-based product suite. You will own system-level design decisions, establish cross-cutting architectural standards, and ensure the platform is secure, observable, performant, and maintainable at enterprise scale. You will apply proven software craftsmanship principles — including 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and design patterns — to guide the team toward a high-quality, long-lived codebase. You will work at the intersection of hands-on technical depth and strategic engineering leadership.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

**1. Architecture and System Design**

* Define and own the technical architecture for WFM, PM, and Platform product areas - spanning Java backend services, frontend systems, APIs, database design, and cloud/on-premises infrastructure.
* Create, maintain, and communicate Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation.
* Lead system-level design reviews; enforce architectural governance and review gates for new features and initiatives.
* Apply and enforce 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and established design patterns across the codebase.
* Design enterprise-grade RESTful API contracts, versioning policies, backward compatibility strategies, and service boundary definitions.
* Architect solutions for both Cloud (AWS/Azure) and On-Premises deployment environments, ensuring consistency and portability.

**2. Java Backend Engineering Excellence**

* Own architectural implementation of Java and Spring Boot microservices, including Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, and integration patterns.
* Define and govern database architecture across PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and other relational stores; own schema design, query optimization, stored procedure standards, and indexing strategy.
* Establish standards for unit and integration testing using PowerMock, Mockito, and JUnit; define test coverage thresholds and enforcement mechanisms.
* Evaluate and govern usage of build tools including Gradle, Maven, and npm; define dependency management and versioning standards.
* Champion secure-by-design practices aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise customer security requirements.

**3. Frontend and Full-Stack Oversight**

* Define frontend architecture standards for ReactJS-based applications, including component design, state management, and performance optimization.
* Govern integration patterns between backend Java services and frontend applications, including API design, authentication (OAuth 2.0/JWT), and error handling.
* Provide architectural guidance on NodeJS services where applicable, including integration with Java backend systems.
* Ensure accessibility, internationalisation (i18n), and cross-browser compatibility are considered in frontend architecture decisions.

**4. DevOps, CI/CD, and Operational Excellence**

* Define CI/CD pipeline architecture using Jenkins and other DevOps tooling; establish standards for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Own deployment architecture for application server environments including Tomcat, JBoss, and Oracle WebLogic Server (14+).
* Establish observability architecture: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting standards for both cloud and on-premises deployments.
* Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; lead post-incident architecture reviews and drive systemic reliability improvements.

**5. Technical Standards, Governance, and Mentorship**

* Define and own engineering standards: coding guidelines, testing strategy, performance benchmarks, scripting conventions (Python, Shell, Batch), and security requirements.
* Establish and maintain the technology radar; govern adoption of third-party libraries, frameworks, and tools.
* Own the technical debt roadmap; prioritize and sequence refactoring and modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the architectural mentor for Senior and Lead engineers; enable the team to make sound design decisions independently.
* Facilitate architecture guilds, design sprints, and tech talks to elevate team-wide architectural thinking.

**6. Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration**

* Partner with global R&D leadership, Product, and Engineering leaders in UK and the US to align architecture with product strategy.
* Provide architectural input into roadmap planning, make-vs-buy evaluations, and platform investment decisions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders including Product, Customer Success, and executive audiences.
* Engage directly with customers and enterprise stakeholders on production issues requiring architectural-level analysis and resolution.

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 12+ years of professional software engineering with 3+ years in a dedicated architecture, principal engineer, or technical lead role.
* B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related STEM field.
* Equivalent exceptional practical experience with a demonstrable architectural portfolio will be considered.
* Demonstrable record of architecting large-scale, multi-tenant enterprise Java applications serving enterprise customers.
* Experience driving architecture across distributed, cross-timezone engineering organizations.

  **Technical Skills:**
* Back-End: Expert-level Java and Spring Boot (Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security). Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Frontend: Strong architectural knowledge of ReactJS. Familiarity with Angular and NodeJS.
* Databases: Expert-level PostgreSQL and MS SQL relational database architecture. Deep SQL query optimization, stored procedure design, schema migration, and indexing strategy.
* Application Servers: Oracle WebLogic Server (14+), Tomcat, and JBoss/WildFly.
* Build and Tooling: Gradle, Maven, npm. IDE expertise with IntelliJ IDEA and Eclipse.
* Testing: Expert-level JUnit, Mockito, PowerMock, and integration testing strategy.
* Scripting: Python, Shell Script, and Batch Script for automation and operational tooling.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS or Azure architecture. Docker and Kubernetes. IaC fundamentals (Terraform or CloudFormation).
* CI/CD: Jenkins pipeline architecture and CI/CD platform design.

  **Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications:**
* Experience in WFM, PM, or enterprise analytics SaaS domains.
* Familiarity with Verint WFO, PM product architecture.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience with TOGAF, C4 model, or equivalent architectural frameworks.
* Contributions to open-source projects or published technical content.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance architecture (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

7d668c4f.title: Enterprise Agentic Automation Developer/Solutions Architect
7d668c4f.description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Information Technology****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18884****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent years building enterprise systems that actually solve business problems, not just demonstrate technical capability. You understand that the real challenge is not deploying an AI model, it is designing the solution architecture that makes it trustworthy, scalable, and maintainable across Finance, HR, Sales Operations, and Legal teams who need it to work every single day. You think in systems, not features. When someone describes a manual process, you are already mapping the integration points, data flows, governance requirements, and failure modes before they finish talking.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an agentic AI architecture with a VP of Finance and writing Python code to integrate Azure OpenAI with SAP. You have built enough automation solutions to know when a workflow needs intelligent document processing versus a simple API call, and you can explain that tradeoff clearly. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate with stakeholders who may not speak your technical language but absolutely know their business pain.

At Synopsys, you will architect AI and automation solutions that reduce manual work for 30,000 employees across critical business functions, and the platform you build will matter.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and build enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, and Copilot Studio that automate Finance, Sales Operations, HR, Order Management, and Legal processes
* Architect and develop agentic AI systems and intelligent automation workflows on UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Functions that integrate with SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, and Workday
* Lead end-to-end solution delivery from requirements gathering and architecture design through development, testing, deployment, and production support
* Build reusable frameworks, integration patterns, and engineering standards for AI agent development that other developers can adopt across the enterprise automation portfolio
* Partner directly with business stakeholders in Finance, GTM, HR, and Operations to identify automation opportunities, assess feasibility, prioritize initiatives, and translate requirements into technical solutions
* Establish and enforce governance, security, Responsible AI practices, and DevOps standards using Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD and source control
* Mentor developers on AI solution design, Azure architecture, integration patterns, and automation best practices

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Reduce manual effort across Finance, Sales Operations, HR, and Order Management by deploying AI-powered automation that handles document processing, data extraction, workflow orchestration, and decision support at scale
* Accelerate Synopsys' enterprise AI strategy by establishing reusable frameworks and patterns that enable faster, more consistent delivery of intelligent automation solutions across business functions
* Improve operational accuracy and compliance by building governed, auditable AI systems with proper security controls, error handling, and monitoring
* Enable business growth without proportional headcount increases by creating scalable automation platforms that handle increasing transaction volumes and process complexity
* Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by translating technical capabilities into business value that Finance, HR, and Operations leaders can understand and trust
* Build institutional knowledge and capability by mentoring developers and establishing engineering standards that raise the quality and maintainability of the entire automation portfolio
Drive measurable ROI through solutions that demonstrably* time, reduce errors, and improve process efficiency in production environments

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 8-12+ years building enterprise applications, automation solutions, or integration platforms, with at least 3 years working directly with AI or Generative AI technologies in production environments
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Services including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search, plus Azure Integration Services like Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and API Management
* Proven ability to design and deploy intelligent automation using platforms like UiPath, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and Dataverse
* Strong development skills in Python, C#, and JavaScript, with solid understanding of REST APIs, SOAP, webhooks, SQL, and data modeling
* Direct experience integrating enterprise applications such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SuccessFactors, or Workday in complex business environments
* Working knowledge of AI governance, Responsible AI practices, cloud security, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control using Azure DevOps or GitHub, experience with JIRA for project management is a plus

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a room with a Finance Director who describes a month-end close process and walk out with a solution architecture that addresses the real bottleneck, not just the symptom they mentioned
* You write code that other developers can actually maintain, you document your integration patterns, you build error handling that helps operations teams diagnose issues without calling you at midnight
* You push back when a stakeholder asks for an AI agent but the problem actually needs a well-designed workflow, and you can explain why in terms they understand and respect
* You have shipped enough production systems to know that governance, security, and supportability are not afterthoughts, they are design constraints you bake in from the start
* You mentor junior developers by showing them how you think through a problem, not just handing them the answer, and you genuinely care about raising the technical capability of the team
* You stay current with AI and automation technology not because it is trendy but because you know the difference between a useful new capability and vendor hype, and you can evaluate both critically

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Enterprise Agentic Process Automation team, which drives business transformation through AI, intelligent automation, process optimization, and enterprise integration. The team delivers capabilities across Finance, Sales Operations, Order Management, HR, Business Operations, and other functions, with emphasis on operational efficiency, scalability, governance, and innovation. Current initiatives include AI agents, document intelligence, finance automation, process orchestration, and enterprise platform integrations. The team operates in Bengaluru and collaborates closely with business stakeholders and IT teams across Synopsys globally.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

The VP, Solutions Architect is a pivotal role for the assigned product specialty area vertical growth agenda and provide Clients with compelling Digital Solutions. This role will work closely with prospect/client (“client”) and ResultsCX (RCX) stakeholders, as well as RCX internal partners, to drive an innovation agenda to meet the client’s strategic goals. The role should additionally support the Transformation Roadmap for Large Multi-Tower Deals, in new Geos or with new Service Offerings.

Establish partnerships to work collaboratively with internal and external constituencies to drive a cohesive solution.

Drive the process with a sense of urgency, but always being mindful of delivering a quality driven solution that include:

* Timely responses to proposals, and contractual obligations.
* Development and delivery of client presentations and solutions.

* Identify client challenges and recommend implementation options.

* Architect customer solutions using innovative and cutting-edge solutions.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in area of Business, Management, Marketing, Finance or other closely degree. Equivalent experience may be substituted for education.
* A minimum of 16 years of progressive leadership experience in roles demonstrating growth, creative and operational excellence; demonstrable success in defining and driving comprehensive programs to transform customer experience and delivering concrete business value.
* Strong background and executional experience in industry area experience transformation technology/platform domain areas as it relates to back office (F&A, Supply Chain, etc.) and/or customer facing areas, with solid (top tier or boutique) consulting company experience preferred. Digital agency experience also relevant.

**About M&G India**

We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

**About M&G**

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

• To work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls you are responsible for to support improvement of the overall control environment, customers outcomes and a reduction in M&G plc's operational risk. • Own end-to-end delivery across assigned squad(s) or workstreams, from demand and initiation through planning, execution, release and closure, with clear accountability for delivery confidence, delivery health and outcome achievement. • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, success measures, priorities, scope boundaries and acceptance expectations. • Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, release forecasts and milestones; communicate confidence, assumptions, options and trade-offs in business language, including the impact of delivery choices on cost, capacity, scope, risk and timelines. • Manage Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective; ensure each sprint has a clear goal, realistic commitment and actionable improvement outcomes. • Coach teams in Scrum and Lean practices as appropriate, while protecting team self-organisation and avoiding command-and-control task allocation. • Ensure backlogs and work items meet the agreed Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and that Jira data provides reliable traceability and delivery insight. • Actively manage RAID, cross-team dependencies, decisions, blockers, resource constraints and third-party commitments; escalate early with clear impact and recovery options. • Orchestrate delivery across squads, platforms and workstreams by managing decision flow, cross-squad dependencies, sequencing constraints and delivery assurance activities. • Use evidence and metrics such as predictability, throughput, cycle time, ageing work, escaped defects, release outcomes and team improvement trends to guide decisions. • Track delivery against intended benefits, measurable value, business outcomes and agreed success criteria, ensuring progress is visible beyond activity completion. • Coordinate release readiness across testing, architecture, security, risk, change, service management and application support, including operational handover, runbooks, monitoring, support contacts and known issues. • Maintain transparent stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, governance updates, demonstrations and decision forums, ensuring no surprises; own delivery input into senior governance forums, steering updates, escalation discussions and leadership reporting where required. • Promote quality, resilience, security, regulatory compliance and control adherence throughout the delivery lifecycle, including ownership of change-control readiness, audit evidence and regulatory delivery obligations where applicable. • Facilitate/participate in Scrum of Scrums or equivalent dependency forums where required and contribute to delivery standards, templates, communities of practice and continuous improvement, with focus on portfolio/workstream alignment, delivery risk visibility and consistent delivery assurance practices. • Create an inclusive, psychologically safe and accountable team environment where constructive challenge, learning and feedback are encouraged. • Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and delivery colleagues and share reusable practices across the delivery community.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

49741ea9.title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
49741ea9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.  
  
Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.  
  
We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.  
  
We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -
  
  

* Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
* Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

  
A day in the life  
TFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.  
  
About the team  
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with ~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.

------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

---------------

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.  
  
WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.  
  
WW R&R is dedicated to providing the best-in-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk & avoid policy abuse.  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Program Manager who has a passion for working in cross-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven program management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.  
  
Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will:  
Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund programs to improve customer trust  
Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer-facing and financial impact  
Be a PM, required to collaborate cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design comprehensive, scalable and automated solutions to fulfil the returns policies customers avail and preserve CX.  
  
A day in the life  
You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new solution is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two competing solutions. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a program's exposure to failure modes.  
  
About the team  
WW Returns , plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech & Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end-to-end execution.

1284c983.title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
1284c983.description:
**Description**
Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) provides the technology infrastructure backbone of every Amazon fulfillment site globally — and Quick Commerce is rewriting the rules of how that infrastructure gets built. This role will be the single threaded leader Quick commerce tech infrastructure for an entire country.
  
  
Quick Commerce demands a fundamentally different approach: frugal, vendor-managed infrastructure that launches at unprecedented velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade availability. As the country's single-threaded infrastructure owner, you will define the network and device strategy that enables Amazon to launch and operate hundreds of sites at speed and at a fraction of traditional cost. You will own the country-level technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, govern availability and financial outcomes, and partner directly with senior business operations leadership. Quick Commerce is the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores, and team NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) shapes its technology backbone.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The NANO TIPM owns the country-level infrastructure strategy — defining architecture standards and readiness criteria against which all site launches execute. For network infrastructure, the TIPM owns end-to-end scope from vendor selection through SLA governance through financial outcome. For End-User Equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers), the TIPM owns identification and recommendation while partnering with Device Tech for certification. The role's responsibilities fall into four themes — Theme 1 sets the framework, Theme 2 executes, Theme 3 governs, and Theme 4 feeds business needs back into Theme 1.
  
  
Theme 1 — Strategy, Vendor Management, and Contract Governance: Own the country's network technology roadmap, drive vendor selection end-to-end, and identify end user devices meeting regional cost and performance targets across all applicable site types.
  
  
Theme 2 — Site Launch and Network Deployment: Define playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where decisions carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority.
  
  
Theme 3 — Operations Excellence, Governance, and Financial Accountability: Own network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet, driving vendor performance through structured governance cadences.
  
  
Theme 4 — Partnership with Business Operations Leadership: Translate the country's business growth priorities into infrastructure strategy, surfacing performance insights, capacity risks, and cost tradeoffs that inform decisions across the region.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce in India — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction versus legacy models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor decisions that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography
  
  
**About The Team**
The NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) team sits within Operations Infrastructure Services and exists to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. The team owns the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of the use cases today, scaling from ~500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with the enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience managing large-scale projects from end to end

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field

**Location:**
