5ce53a46.title: Program Manager II, ShipTech, ShipTech
5ce53a46.description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, come join us at Amazon.
  
  
ShipTech is the connective tissue, which connects Transportation Service Providers, First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile to facilitate the shipping of billions of packages each year. Due to criticality of the ShipTech systems, world-wide (WW) Amazon business organizations work with ShipTech every year to deliver their programs for network expansion, operational efficiency improvement, new feature delivery to enhance customer/operator experience, compliance asks, etc. WW requestors submit intakes to deliver: (1) on-boarding new shippers, carriers, and services to the shipping network, (2) facilitating package movement and tracking in Amazon and third-party (3P) network, (3) changes in carrier artifacts like a label and manifest, (4) carrier configurations like routing codes, account ids, and (5) custom tech-builds for meeting business specific asks delivered by ShipTech every year (6) support improvement in the quality of Amazon’s worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones
  
  
We are looking for a Program Manager to be a part of our effort to drive program for improving visibility and tracking capabilities for Amazon shipments. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Operations by improving shipment tracking logic and capabilities for different legs of logistics, customer messaging, validation of transportation milestones, enable logic for automated shipment workflows and improve quality of shipment tracking within and outside Amazon partners. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business team, Operations stakeholders, Tech teams, recipient experience teams and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive improvement in worldwide shipment infrastructure by defining the usage, configuration, and standardization of transportation milestones.
* Drive initiatives to improvement accuracy of shipment visibility for improving improve customer experience
* Conducting evaluation of existing workflows and drive initiative to be Amazon central authority on workflows
* Identify and execute data driven workstreams to identify gaps in current infrastructure (Both tech and business rules) and define future state along with roadmap
* Improve the worldwide customer experience and operations visibility through accurate and informative delivery status of milestones.
* Execute our program and project initiatives, while providing great internal customer support and driving consistency, help us continue to support our initiatives, and identify process improvement opportunities
* Work with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders which includes worldwide Transportation, ATS, AMZL, Customer Service, Customer Experience, Product, and Tech teams.
* Communicate project statuses and updates across a global audience. Experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization
* Manage competing priorities and drive alignment with leadership from different teams to implement the optimal solves for worldwide network

A day in the life
  
  
The ideal candidate must be detail-oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple stakeholders at once, able to work independently, and maintain professionalism under pressure. This role will need to have knowledge in analytical skills and in excel. The Program Manager will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have good problem-solving abilities. This position will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a team of program managers who work across 20+ platform tech teams. Our stakeholders are transportation teams across regions. We contribute to several large-scale high-visibility programs each year such as network expansion projects like market place launches and carrier launches, and new feature build outs to provide enhanced customer experience or better operational efficiencies. We also support several compliance programs across our worldwide stakeholders. We are looking for a Program Manager to work with global business customers and our engineering teams to support intake requests related to new carrier on-boarding and ship method integrations.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI HYD 13 SEZ

**About Diversified**
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.

At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**

This is a senior, presales-focused service architecture role responsible for supporting complex, multi-element, service-led opportunities from early discovery through solution design, commercial modelling, contractual definition, and executive presentation.

* Contractually clear

In parallel, the role contributes to the development of scalable, repeatable service offerings, supporting long-term service & revenue growth, and portfolio evolution.

* Architect complex, multi-element managed services, support agreements, and staffing models
* Drive the use of standardized, repeatable service components to ensure scalability, consistency, and margin efficiency
* Ensure all solutions align with established service offerings, delivery models, operational capabilities, and support frameworks
* Define clear acceptance criteria to support seamless transition into service delivery
* Produce high-quality, executive-level proposals and detailed solution documentation
* Commercial & Contractual Responsibility

* Clearly define and document all assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, and constraints to protect delivery integrity
* Own and assure the quality of Statements of Work (SOW), ensuring contractual clarity across scope, SLAs, deliverables, and obligations
* Support contract review and redlining activities, ensuring alignment between solution design, commercial position, and contractual commitments
* Complex Deal & RFPs

* Coordinate cross-functional inputs from Sales, Operations, Delivery, and Pre-Sales teams
* Participate in client workshops, presentations, and executive-level solution discussions
* Support commercial negotiations relating to service scope, SLAs, and delivery commitments

* Delivery Readiness & Assurance

* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, and constraints, and define appropriate mitigation strategies
* Validate solution delivery capability across global and regional delivery models
* Support structured handover into delivery teams, ensuring clarity and continuity
* Use feedback from delivery teams and clients to continuously improve solution design, standards, and assumptions
* Service Development
* Identify gaps and opportunities within our services portfolio
* Partner with services offering team, sales and service leadership to develop scalable, repeatable service offerings aligned to market demand
* Collaborate with OEMs and technology partners to shape lifecycle, consulting, and XaaS-based services
* Sales Enablement & Growth
* Support and guide Account Executives in qualifying service-led opportunities using clear qualification criteria
* Work with Service and Sales leadership to improve service attachment rates across project and technology sales
* Contribute to the development of service scoping tools, pricing frameworks, and proposal templates in collaboration with the services offering team
* Prioritise engagement on high-value, complex, and strategic opportunities

**Required Skills/Qualifications**

* 5+ years’ experience within AV, Unified Communications, or technology services environments
* Proven experience architecting managed services and lifecycle support solutions
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise Account Executives on complex presales engagements
* Experience designing SLA frameworks, governance models, and service transition approaches
* Strong experience in commercial modelling, pricing structures, and margin management
* Experience contributing to or leading service workstreams within complex RFP/RFI responses

**Technical & Commercial Capability**

* Ability to solution scalable, repeatable service solutions aligned to commercial and operational objectives
* Sound commercial judgement with clear understanding of cost drivers, margin protection, and contractual risk

**Preferred Skills/Qualifications**

* Exposure to multi-site or global enterprise service models

* Experience collaborating with OEMs and technology vendors to shape service propositions

**Core Competencies**

* Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decision-making
* Structured and analytical approach to complex service challenges

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**
To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.

196207ba.title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
196207ba.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

04d231c7.description:
Our team is expanding, and we're bringing on a Solution Architect with deep specialization in Python and Generative AI to build and deliver enterprise-grade GenAI solutions ready for real-world production use. You'll be an integral part of our Solution Architecture group, spearheading technical exploration efforts, crafting reusable frameworks, and shaping standards for LLM-based applications. Submit your application to take part in forward-thinking GenAI initiatives and empower clients to achieve breakthrough outcomes.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Architect complete GenAI systems, including RAG frameworks, Agents, and Multi-Agent configurations, tailored for enterprise-level clients
* Develop reusable accelerators and reference builds to bring consistency to delivery approaches
* Facilitate technical discovery workshops while offering direct, practical support to engineering teams
* Establish evaluation methodologies and set standards for building large language model (LLM) applications
* Work alongside diverse teams to guarantee system designs that scale effectively and remain easy to maintain
* Build out microservices-based architectures leveraging established design patterns and contemporary frameworks
* Manage the incorporation of cloud infrastructure elements across platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Handle containerization and orchestration processes utilizing Docker and Kubernetes
* Assess and choose suitable vector database solutions, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma, for GenAI use cases
* Deploy LLMOps methodologies and monitoring solutions to fine-tune production-level deployments
* Assist with prompt management and RAG evaluation processes to boost application precision
* Take part in mentoring efforts and knowledge exchange across the broader architecture team
* Maintain high standards of production-ready code quality within Python-based applications
* Push forward ongoing enhancements in system architecture and solution scalability

**Requirements**

* Between 9 and 14 years of experience in software development, with a strong foundation in solution architecture and system design
* Advanced Python development skills with a focus on writing production-ready code
* Skilled in microservices design, architectural patterns, FastAPI, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Kafka
* Substantial background building GenAI applications, covering Agents, MCP, RAG, Agentic RAG, and GraphRAG
* Strong familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, and related orchestration tools
* Hands-on background in evaluating LLMs and RAG systems, along with managing prompts
* Demonstrated success in delivering scalable GenAI applications ready for production environments
* Working experience with cloud ecosystems such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Comfortable with containerization tools, namely Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with vector database technologies, including Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma
* Solid grasp of LLMOps principles and associated monitoring solutions
* Strong leadership capabilities suited to directing engineering teams
* Capacity to thrive in client-facing settings while working collaboratively
* Solid English communication skills, both written and spoken, at B2 level or above

**Nice to have**

* Experience in conventional machine learning practices, including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation methods
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs along with fine-tuning approaches
* Previous background in consulting positions or client-facing capacities

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
TTEC Digital – Google Delivery Practice is seeking a Google CCAI Architect to lead the design and implementation of AI-powered self-service solutions for enterprise contact centers. This role will provide end-to-end technical leadership across voice and digital AI engagements, working closely with clients and internal teams to deliver scalable, innovative customer experience solutions using Google Cloud technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead voice and digital AI self-service solutions for large, multi-location contact centers.
  
  
Design, develop, and implement AI self-service applications using
**Google Contact Center AI**
.
  
  
Interface directly with clients to lead design decisions and define solution requirements.
  
  
Serve as project lead for assigned Google CCAI implementations.
  
  
Collaborate with conversation designers and project teams on IVA specifications.
  
  
Integrate solutions with backend systems using web services, APIs, and databases.
  
  
Perform unit testing and support system and functional testing activities.
  
  
Guide and mentor developers as needed.
  
  
**Technical Expertise**
8+ years of overall architecture experience.
  
  
4+ years of experience with
**Dialogflow CX**
/ Dialogflow ES.
  
  
2+ years of hands-on experience with
**Google Contact Center AI**
.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Cloud Services Architecture,
**Apigee**
, and
**Vertex AI**
.
  
  
Experience integrating Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech services (Google, Amazon, Nuance).
  
  
Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, .NET, C#, HTML, SQL, Python, Node.js, AngularJS.
  
  
Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and backend integrations.
  
  
Database experience: SQL, Oracle, MongoDB, PostgreSQL.
  
  
Experience managing large multi-site contact center implementations.
  
  
**Competency**
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
  
  
Ability to lead technical discussions and drive solution architecture decisions.
  
  
Capability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  
  
Strong documentation skills (Solution Design Documents / IVA specifications).
  
  
Self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented.

Google Technologies:

,
**Dialogflow CX**
,
**Apigee**
,
**Vertex AI**

, Five9

f9393df6.description:
**Description**
**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client’s current and desired end states
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including B2B commerce on core, Sales, Service, andCommunity clouds
* Understanding of B2B sales processes, customer journeys, and e-commerce best practices.
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, ESB, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Understanding of B2B Commerce Einstein Features & Capabilities
* Understanding B2B Commerce Extensions framework
* Understanding on B2B Commerce APIs and Connect APIs
* Understanding of cross cloud use cases (B2B, D2C, Loyalty, Revenue)
* Understanding of Salesforce OMS
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Ability to clearly articulate complex technical situations to business and management audiences

c66a8098.title: CCaaS Architect - Amazon Connect
c66a8098.description:
We are seeking an experienced **CCaaS Architect** to lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale Amazon Connect solutions. The ideal candidate will bring 12–20 years of overall IT experience, with deep expertise in contact center modernization, AWS architecture and large-scale CCaaS migrations.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design and implementation of enterprise CCaaS solutions using Amazon Connect and supporting AWS services
* Define and execute contact center modernization and migration strategies from legacy platforms to Amazon Connect
* Architect scalable IVR, contact flows, intelligent routing, conversational AI and omnichannel customer engagement solutions
* Design secure and resilient AWS infrastructure, networking, integrations and disaster recovery solutions, ensuring performance, compliance and business continuity
* Lead integration architecture involving Lambda, API Gateway, Lex, CRM systems, enterprise applications and event-driven services
* Drive architecture reviews, performance optimization, troubleshooting and technical governance while guiding engineering teams through implementation and production deployment
* Collaborate with customers and stakeholders on solution workshops, technical estimations, architecture proposals and RFP/RFI responses

**Requirements**

* 12–20 years of overall IT experience, with strong experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale Amazon Connect / CCaaS solutions, including contact flows, IVR, routing profiles, queues, Contact Lens and call recording
* Proven experience in contact center migrations from legacy platforms such as Avaya, Cisco or Genesys to Amazon Connect, including migration planning and execution
* Expertise in AWS architecture and core services, including Lambda, API Gateway and IAM
* Knowledge of VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch and EventBridge
* Strong experience in end-to-end solution architecture, covering networking, security, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO and regional failover strategies
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Lex, Lambda and Amazon Polly, along with Transcribe and Kinesis
* Understanding of enterprise integration architecture, including CRM platforms, hybrid connectivity, cross-account security, performance optimization and troubleshooting
* Proven ability to create HLD/LLD, architecture diagrams and technical solutions, with strong customer-facing consulting and stakeholder management experience

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, Generative AI and Agentic AI for intelligent contact center solutions
* Experience implementing Agent Assist, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, conversation summarization and AI-powered self-service
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or relevant Amazon Connect certification

6de6c76f.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what?s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor?s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix? Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix? Assessment 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
This is a techno-functional business growth role focused on shaping and accelerating Persistent?s Data, Analytics, and AI business across strategic accounts and target markets. The role partners closely with sales, partnerships, delivery, and practice teams to identify high-value opportunities, define go-to-market priorities, shape differentiated solutions, and support commercial success. The Principal Consultant is expected to bring a strong blend of market understanding, enterprise Data and AI solution knowledge, executive client engagement, commercial acumen, and cross-functional leadership. This role will help drive pipeline, improve pursuit quality, manage offering evolution, and support expansion across key accounts.
  
  

* Role: Principal ? Offerings & Solutions, Data, Analytics & AI
* Location: All Persistent Locations
* Experience: 12 to 20 years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with sales leadership, partnerships, delivery, and CoE teams to drive growth for Persistent?s Data, Analytics, and AI portfolio.
* Identify and prioritize target market segments, strategic accounts, and high-potential offerings across existing and new clients.
* Define and continuously refine go-to-market strategies, account plays, and solution offerings based on market demand, competitive positioning, and client priorities.
* Lead the development of industry and account-specific points of view and offerings that connect Persistent?s offerings to measurable business outcomes.
* Engage senior client stakeholders to understand transformation priorities, shape conversations, and position Persistent as a strategic partner.
* Influence strategic pursuits through solution framing, value articulation, commercial input, and deal-shaping discussions.
* Work with internal teams to develop and package differentiated offerings, reusable assets, and strategic solution narratives for the market.
* Co-develop business plans and targeted account plans with the GTM Leaders to strengthen pipeline generation, account penetration, and expansion potential.
* Drive internal and external evangelization of Persistent?s Data, Analytics, and AI capabilities through executive presentations, workshops, customer meetings, and industry events.
* Take structured market, client, and field feedback into offering strategy, roadmap priorities, pricing considerations, and packaging decisions.
* Manage transition from pursuit to delivery by ensuring clarity of solution intent, business context, and client expectations.
* Enable cross-sell and up-sell opportunities by identifying adjacent transformation needs across the client landscape.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Over 12 years of experience across growth consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, enterprise architecture, consulting, or data and analytics delivery roles in medium to large enterprise environments.
* Strong familiarity with enterprise Data, Analytics, and AI technologies, platforms, and transformation programs, and how they create business value.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders across business and technology functions.
* Strong commercial sense, including experience supporting deal shaping, value positioning, pursuit strategy, and complex client opportunities.
* Proven ability to translate market signals and customer needs into solution opportunities, go-to-market priorities, and growth actions.
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, especially in client-facing and leadership-facing settings.
* Ability to work across multiple internal groups and align sales, delivery, pre-sales and practice stakeholders around a growth agenda.
* Strategic thinking combined with strong execution discipline and attention to detail.
* Experience creating business cases, client narratives, pursuit collateral, and market-facing solution content.
* Prior exposure to partner and alliance-led growth motions.
* Domain Knowledge in one or more core industry verticals such as Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, Consumer, or Industrials.
* Experience influencing offering evolution, solution packaging, pricing inputs, or account strategy in a technology services environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data modernization, analytics transformation, AI adoption, and related platform ecosystems.
* Meeting pipeline targets and strategic account growth targets
* Quality and impact of solution positioning across pursuits
* Ability to lead cross-sell, up-sell initiatives

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

3f40c524.title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
3f40c524.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**

9ed44262.title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
9ed44262.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT or a related discipline; a professional accounting or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* HighRadius certification (Cash Application, Collections or Credit) and / or SAP S/4HANA FI-AR or FSCM certification is preferred. Solution-architecture, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.

* HighRadius. Functional lead or architect on at least two full-lifecycle HighRadius implementations covering Cash Application, Collections and / or Credit Management — from fit-gap and design through configuration, testing, deployment and stabilisation — ideally integrated with SAP.
* End-to-end Credit to Cash. Deep functional understanding of the whole value chain — credit, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close — and evidence of designing across it as one solution, not only within a single module. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* SAP and integration. Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections, Dispute Management) in S/4HANA or ECC, and experience defining functional integration with banks, lockbox / bank statement formats, EDI and third-party C2C platforms.
* Transformation. * Enterprise-level CSM architecture: multi-brand/multi-entity case management, complex entitlement models
* Architectural decisions on CSM-FSM-ITSM-ITAM integration points and shared data models (e.g., CSDM alignment)

* Governance of playbook, Advanced Work Assignment, and Major Issue Management design patterns at scale
* Experience architecting CSM for regulated or high-compliance industries

**Integration**

* Enterprise integration architecture: eBonding, ESB/middleware strategy, Integration Hub vs. custom build decisions
* Data governance across integrated systems: master data ownership, reconciliation, and conflict resolution strategy
* Security architecture for integrations: zero-trust considerations, API gateway strategy, MID Server topology at scale

* Architectural guardrails for generative AI features: data boundaries, hallucination risk, human-in-the-loop design
* Evaluating build-vs-buy decisions for AI capabilities (OOB Now Assist vs. custom LLM integration)
* Advising leadership on responsible-AI governance, data privacy, and regulatory considerations for AI-driven features
* Experience presenting AI roadmap and ROI narratives to client executive stakeholders

* Multiple CIS certifications across CSM, Integration, and other relevant modules
* Prior experience as a solution architect across a full ServiceNow program (not a single module)

* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

9b3d896b.title: CCaaS Architect - Amazon Connect
9b3d896b.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **CCaaS Architect** to drive the design and rollout of enterprise-grade Amazon Connect solutions. The successful candidate should have 12–20 years of broad IT experience, with strong knowledge of contact center modernization, AWS architecture, and large-scale CCaaS migrations.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Spearhead the complete architecture, design, and deployment of enterprise CCaaS solutions leveraging Amazon Connect and related AWS services
* Develop and implement contact center modernization and migration roadmaps for transitioning from legacy platforms to Amazon Connect
* Design scalable IVR systems, contact flows, intelligent routing, conversational AI, and omnichannel engagement solutions
* Build secure, resilient AWS infrastructure—covering networking, integrations, and disaster recovery—while ensuring performance, compliance, and continuity of operations
* Oversee integration architecture spanning Lambda, API Gateway, Lex, CRM platforms, enterprise systems, and event-driven services
* Conduct architecture reviews, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and technical governance, while mentoring engineering teams through build-out and go-live
* Partner with clients and stakeholders during solution workshops, technical scoping, architecture proposals, and RFP/RFI submissions

**Requirements**

* 12–20 years of overall IT background, with hands-on expertise in architecting and deploying enterprise-level Amazon Connect/CCaaS solutions—spanning contact flows, IVR, routing profiles, queues, Contact Lens, and call recording
* Demonstrated success migrating contact centers from legacy systems (such as Avaya, Cisco, or Genesys) to Amazon Connect, including both planning and execution phases
* Deep knowledge of AWS architecture and foundational services like Lambda, API Gateway, and IAM
* Familiarity with VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and EventBridge
* Solid background in end-to-end solution architecture, including networking, security, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO, and regional failover planning
* Practical experience using Amazon Lex, Lambda, and Amazon Polly, as well as Transcribe and Kinesis
* Strong grasp of enterprise integration architecture—covering CRM systems, hybrid connectivity, cross-account security, performance tuning, and issue resolution
* Track record of producing HLD/LLD documentation, architecture diagrams, and technical solutions, paired with strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder engagement skills

**Nice to have**

* Practical exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Generative AI, and Agentic AI for building intelligent contact center solutions
* Background in deploying Agent Assist, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, conversation summarization, and AI-driven self-service tools
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification or an equivalent Amazon Connect credential

86dfbabe.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
86dfbabe.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Solution Architect specializing in HCL Commerce** to lead the design and evolution of a multi-tier B2B commerce platform, guiding architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi-tier B2B commerce, encompassing WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Lead the design of dual-run / strangler patterns, determining which journeys remain on WCS and which migrate to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and defining cut-over and rollback procedures
* Produce and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), identifying reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Partner with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut-over activities
* Establish coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to ensure consistency across squads
* Guide integration with back-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), maintaining clear distinction between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer-facing) Commerce environments
* Review designs and pull requests for Commerce, services, and storefront layers, resolving complex cross-layer defects at their root cause
* Advise on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high-traffic B2B storefront
* Mentor senior engineers and leads, documenting architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to ensure continuity
* Identify key barriers and apply structured problem-solving approaches to complex, multi-system challenges

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
* 12-20 years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years in an architect or equivalent principal/staff design role on large commerce or similarly complex multi-tier systems
* 8+ years of expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, covering store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back-end integration
* 8+ years of expertise in Java / J2EE and OOD on large IT systems, with WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred
* 5+ years of experience in Spring / Spring MVC with hands-on Spring Boot architecture, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* 5+ years of experience in web services (REST and SOAP), with the ability to specify contracts for other teams to implement
* Production architecture experience with Next.js and React, including routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance; TypeScript preferred
* 5+ years of experience with source control, Git required
* Background in architecting B2B commerce, including punchout, org/user models, and contract/pricing complexity preferred
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with engineers and non-engineers

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of headless/composable commerce (API-first storefront, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or similar iPaaS
* Familiarity with search (Solr or equivalent), cache (Redis or equivalent), and CMS-driven storefront (Optimizely or equivalent) alongside a commerce engine
* Experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or equivalent) for storefront and Spring Boot, and WAS/IHS for Commerce
* Understanding of security, PCI-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management across legacy and modern storefronts
* Background in dual-run or large-scale commerce migration projects
