e02c2cff.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
e02c2cff.description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

e10d4ab7.title: Presales Consultant
e10d4ab7.description:
**Company Description**
COREVISION TECHNOLOGY PRIVATE LIMITED is a technology-focused organization based in India, offering solutions and services to help businesses optimize their operations and drive growth. The company is committed to delivering value through innovation, dependable implementation, and customer-centric engagement. Team members collaborate across functions to design and deliver solutions that address complex business challenges. The work environment encourages learning, professional development, and the application of analytical and consulting skills to real-world client needs.

**Role Description**
The Presales Consultant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. 1765a0ad.title: Tech Architect
1765a0ad.description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Working knowledge of compliance and data-control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, including privacy and data-retention considerations for aerial imagery and video. Regulated-industry experience is a plus, not mandatory.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading architecture reviews and building consensus across engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with drone SDKs/platforms such as DJI, MAVLink, PX4, or ArduPilot, or with drone fleet and mission-management software.
* Experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tooling, including GIS, orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction, GDAL, or PostGIS.
* Experience with edge/on-device inference or low-latency real-time video processing at a ground station or on a drone.
* Experience with video analytics platforms or stream-processing frameworks such as GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream, or Triton Inference Server.
* Experience building a developer ecosystem or marketplace, including partner APIs, app/extension marketplaces, and developer portals.
* Experience with zero-trust architecture, mutual TLS (mTLS), WAF/API-gateway policy design, or security tooling such as SAST/DAST and SIEM integrations.
* Experience with API monetization, usage-based billing, or SaaS metering systems.
* Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications or agents in production.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-tooling frameworks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience with SRE practices, including SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and capacity planning.
* Prior experience scaling SaaS systems from startup to enterprise scale.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, or security certifications.

**Role Expectations**

* Be a hands-on technical leader who can move fluidly between architecture, implementation, code review, production readiness, and technical mentoring.
* Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Build consensus across teams and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Application note: Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate hands-on backend engineering, productionizing POCs, SaaS architecture, drone-media/data pipeline design, enterprise SSO and security architecture, and practical use of AI-assisted coding tools.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

1ce0ae65.title: Technical Lead- Architecture and Engineering
1ce0ae65.company: Smartkheti Products, Opulent Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
1ce0ae65.description:
Build the technology that helps solve India’s water crisis

Chandigarh Tricity | Full-time | On-site

7–10 years preferred | 6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

At **Wattr.ai**, we are building technology for one of India's most important and complex challenges — **water**.

We are creating the digital intelligence layer for real-world water infrastructure, connecting sensors, field systems, data, software and AI to help organisations monitor, understand and manage water infrastructure at scale.

And we are looking for a Technical Lead who wants to **own the technology behind it.**

This is not a role where you simply receive requirements and write tickets.

You will work across the entire product-engineering chain:

**Business Requirement → Product Requirement → System Architecture → Technical Design → Engineering Sprints → Task Allocation → Development → Testing → Deployment → Production → Scale**

**You will architect it.**

**You will build it.**

**You will lead the engineering team that executes it.**

**You will own technical delivery against product goals, KPIs and deadlines.**

What you will own

You will be the technical bridge between the **Product team and Engineering team**, translating what the business needs into systems that can actually be built, deployed and scaled.

You will:

→ Understand business and product requirements and convert them into technical solutions

→ Design the overall system architecture — application, APIs, databases, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure and integrations

→ Break architecture and product requirements into engineering modules, technical tasks and deliverables

→ Plan and drive engineering sprints based on product priorities, dependencies and deadlines

→ Assign work across developers based on technical complexity, priorities and individual strengths

→ Track sprint execution and ensure engineering commitments translate into actual product delivery

→ Identify technical risks, dependencies and bottlenecks early and drive them to resolution

→ Remain hands-on with development, particularly on critical or complex components

→ Review architecture, code and implementation decisions to maintain engineering quality

→ Work closely with Product to balance speed, scalability, reliability and business priorities

→ Own technical delivery from **0→1 and beyond**, taking products from an idea to a field-tested production system

Technology you will work across

This is a broad technical ownership role. You should be comfortable going deep across multiple layers of the stack:

**Frontend → Backend → APIs → Data → Real-time Systems → IoT → Cloud → Infrastructure → AI**

Full-stack Engineering

Strong hands-on experience with:

* **Node.js** and modern backend development
* **React** and frontend application development
* REST APIs and service integrations
* Databases and data modelling
* Authentication, authorization and application security
* Performance optimisation and production debugging

Cloud & Infrastructure

Strong experience with **AWS** and production cloud systems.

You should understand and ideally have hands-on experience with:

* EC2, S3, RDS / time-series databases and relevant AWS services
* AWS IoT Core or equivalent IoT cloud platforms
* Docker and containerised applications
* Kubernetes / EKS or equivalent
* CI/CD pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform
* Monitoring, logging and observability
* Cloud security, networking and reliability

The expectation is not simply to consume cloud infrastructure — you should understand how to **design, provision and evolve the infrastructure on which the product runs.**

IoT, Real-time & Data Systems

Wattr works with real-world infrastructure and continuously generated data.

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

* IoT platforms and connected devices
* MQTT / pub-sub architectures
* Sensor telemetry and real-time data ingestion
* Event-driven systems
* Kafka or similar streaming technologies
* Data ingestion / ETL pipelines
* Time-series data
* High-volume event processing
* Real-time alerts, monitoring and reporting
* Edge/cloud architectures

You should be comfortable thinking about:

**Device → Data → Backend → Processing → Intelligence → Dashboard → Action**

AI & AI-assisted Engineering

AI is becoming an important part of how we build intelligent infrastructure.

Experience with:

* LLMs / GenAI
* AI APIs and integrations
* RAG / agentic systems
* ML/AI pipelines
* AI-assisted development using tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent is a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in engineers who use AI tools **practically to increase engineering velocity and solve problems better**, rather than simply having theoretical exposure.

Architecture & System Design

Architecture ownership is **mandatory** for this role.

We are looking for someone with at least **2–3 years of genuine hands-on architecture / system-design experience**.

You should have experience with:

* Designing production systems from business requirements
* Defining system and service boundaries
* Making technology and architecture decisions
* Designing APIs and integrations
* Database and data architecture
* Distributed and event-driven systems
* Scalability and performance
* Reliability and fault tolerance
* Security and observability
* Cloud architecture and infrastructure
* Evolving architecture as products scale

Importantly, you should have **built the systems you architected**.

We are not looking for a pure enterprise architect or consulting architect who primarily produces diagrams and documents.

Technical Leadership

You will lead the engineering team technically and drive execution.

This includes:

Translating product requirements into technical plans

Breaking large requirements into manageable engineering tasks

Planning sprints and sequencing technical dependencies

Assigning work to engineers

Reviewing progress against sprint commitments

Unblocking developers when technical issues arise

Conducting code and architecture reviews

Mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards

Working with Product to manage technical trade-offs and delivery priorities

Ensuring engineering execution remains aligned with business KPIs and product deadlines

You may lead a small team of engineers, but **your primary identity should remain that of a strong hands-on engineer and technical leader.**

0→1 Ownership

We want someone who has experienced the journey:

**Idea → Architecture → First Build → MVP → Production → Scale**

You should have personally contributed to taking at least one product, platform or major system from **0→1** and subsequently helped scale or productionise it.

Startup experience is a strong advantage, particularly experience working in environments where engineers have to make decisions independently and move quickly.

What makes this role different

You won't be responsible for just one layer of the technology stack.

You will have visibility into the **entire product**.

You will understand why the product needs to exist → decide how it should be built → architect the system → break it into engineering work → lead the team through execution → write critical code yourself → deploy it → see it working in the real world.

And the real-world application is meaningful.

Water infrastructure

Connected devices

Live operational data

AI-driven intelligence

Large-scale infrastructure

Real impact across India

This is an opportunity to build technology where the systems you design don't just live inside a software product — **they interact with the physical world.**

What success looks like

In your first 6–12 months, you should be able to:

Take ownership of the technical architecture of key Wattr products

Translate product requirements into clear engineering plans

Establish an effective sprint and engineering execution rhythm

Build and ship a field-tested MVP rapidly

Bring live sensor/device data into reliable production systems

Build scalable backend and frontend systems

Establish robust APIs, data pipelines, alerts and reporting

Improve automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and observability

Identify architectural bottlenecks before they become production problems

Help build an engineering culture focused on ownership, quality and delivery

Most importantly:

**The technology you build should become a competitive advantage for Wattr.ai.**

What we're looking for

7–10 years of software engineering experience preferred

6+ years can be considered for an exceptional candidate

**2–3+ years of hands-on architecture / system-design ownership is mandatory**

Strong hands-on full-stack engineering experience

Strong **Node.js + React** experience

Strong AWS / cloud experience

Experience setting up and evolving infrastructure

Strong understanding of APIs, databases and distributed systems

Experience with data pipelines / high-volume or real-time systems

0→1 product or platform development experience

Experience leading or mentoring engineers

Strong sprint planning, task breakdown and engineering execution skills

933fe054.title: Technical Architect – AWS AI Architect
933fe054.description:
Experience: 12+ Years

**Role Summary**

* Architect agentic solutions end to end: task decomposition, tool/function design, memory and state models, orchestration topology (supervisor, hierarchical, sequential, parallel), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* + Design and tune production RAG pipelines — chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, grounding and citation — and own the retrieval quality metrics, not just the pipeline diagram.
* + Build the evaluation layer alongside the system: golden datasets, trace-level assertions, LLM-as-judge rubrics, regression suites that gate deployment.
* + Select and justify the AWS service composition for each workload, with an explicit view on cost, latency, data residency, and failure modes.
* + Define guardrails and the security posture for agents that take real actions: least-privilege tool permissions, prompt injection defenses, PII handling, audit trails.
* + Set engineering standards for the practice — reference architectures, reusable agent and tool patterns, observability conventions — and mentor engineers into them.
* + Partner with client stakeholders on solution shaping, technical discovery, effort estimation, and proof-of-value scoping.

**Why This Role Matters**

Agentic AI systems fail in production for predictable reasons: unmanaged context windows, brittle orchestration, unscoped tool permissions, and no observability into why an agent did what it did. This role exists to prevent that — designing agent architectures on AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) that are secure by default, cost-bounded, evaluable, and built to scale past the POC stage

**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong AWS AI architect with hands-on expertise with At least two agentic or RAG systems taken to production on AWS, with evidence of ownership through the operate phase — not pilots that stopped at demo**.**

**Must-Have Skills**

2-3 year experience in Agentic system design Planning and execution loops, ReAct and plan-execute patterns, tool/function calling design, short- and long-term memory, state persistence and recovery, multi-agent orchestration and handoff design, MCP and A2A for tool and agent interoperability. Practical judgment on when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic workflow is the right one.

2-3 year experience in Agent frameworks Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex. Comfortable dropping to a custom orchestration loop where a framework gets in the way.

3 year experience in RAG engineering Production experience with document processing and chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector and hybrid (BM25 + dense) retrieval, reranking, query decomposition, GraphRAG and agentic RAG patterns, context-window budgeting, and grounding/citation enforcement. Able to diagnose whether a bad answer came from retrieval, ranking, or generation.

AWS AI stack – 3 years of experience –

Amazon Bedrock — Converse API, model selection and routing, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Flows, prompt caching, batch vs. real-time inference and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Code Interpreter, Browser

Amazon SageMaker AI for custom model hosting, training, and endpoint operations and Vector and search: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, S3 Vectors, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, Amazon Kendra.

5 years of experience in AWS core services Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS/Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC and PrivateLink. Able to design a VPC-isolated, private-endpoint deployment for a regulated client without help.

7+ years of experience in Python engineering Production-grade Python — async, typing, Pydantic, FastAPI, structured testing. Clean, reviewable code; not notebook-only.

2+ years of experience Evaluation and LLMOps Offline and online evaluation design, RAGAS or equivalent retrieval metrics, trace-based observability (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, CloudWatch, Langfuse/LangSmith or similar), prompt and model versioning, token and cost governance, drift and regression detection.

2+ years of experience AI security and responsible AI Prompt injection and tool-abuse threat modeling, scoped tool permissions and action approval design, data classification and PII handling, content filtering, auditability. Working familiarity with an AI governance framework such as NIST AI RMF.

**Good to Have**

Model optimization — fine-tuning and LoRA/QLoRA, distillation into smaller or open-weight models, SLM deployment, structured decoding, latency/cost optimization under SLA.

Multimodal and voice — Amazon Nova models, Transcribe, Polly, real-time voice agent architectures and Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — AWS CDK or Terraform, GitHub Actions or CodePipeline, containerization, environment promotion strategy.

Data engineering foundations — AWS Glue, Kinesis, Kafka/Confluent, Lake Formation, Iceberg; designing the ingestion layer that feeds retrieval and Enterprise integration — SharePoint, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Confluence/Jira connectors and their authentication realities.

Regulated-industry delivery — HIPAA, GxP, SOC 2, or FedRAMP contexts; EU AI Act awareness and Frontend for AI — React or Streamlit for rapid proofs of value, streaming UX (SSE/WebSocket), interrupt and approval interfaces.

**What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)**

Agentic AI systems move from prototype to production with defined SLAs, scoped permissions, and continuous evaluation — not fragile demos that break under real usage. Your architectural patterns become the org’s reusable default, cutting time-to-production for every team that builds after you.

**Why Join WinWire: Your Path to Professional Excellence in the Age of AI**

As an **Employer of Choice,** WinWire offers an exceptional workplace culture, industry recognition, and an unwavering commitment to employee growth. Here is why top talent chooses us:

* **AI-First. Globally Recognized**: Honored at the World Economic Forum in Davos for our pioneering "Agentic AI @ Scale" work, cementing our position as a forward-thinking, AI-first services firm shaping the future of enterprise technology.
* **Microsoft Gold Standard**: A **6x Microsoft** Global Partner of the Year Winner/Finalist — reflecting our consistent delivery of industry-leading solutions and our deep, trusted partnership with Microsoft.
* **Joining the NTT DATA Family**: WinWire (Part of NTT DATA), a $30 billion global leader in AI, digital business, and technology services. This means greater career stability, broader client exposure, and access to a vast landscape of opportunities across a truly global organization.
* **Award-Winning Culture**: Certified as a Best Place to Work® four times, our workplace culture is not just a talking point — it is a proven, recognized commitment to creating an environment where people genuinely thrive.
* **People-First Environment**: With a strong 4.0 Glassdoor rating, our employees speak for themselves. We prioritize wellbeing, inclusivity, and a culture of respect at every level of the organization.
* **Invest in Your Growth**: From continuous learning programs to structured career development pathways, we equip our team with the skills, tools, and opportunities needed to grow and lead in the age of AI.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. This role sits in the
**Technology**
group, within the
**Checkout Organization**

The team is responsible for delivering a resilient, multi-tenant, high‑converting Modern Checkout platform, with goals that include driving conversion uplift and revenue growth, converging traffic from Classic platforms into one Modern Checkout platform and launching innovative AI experiences across our stack. As a
**Technical Program Manager III**
in Checkout, you will own end‑to‑end delivery of medium‑to‑complex, cross‑team programs, designing visibility mechanisms, managing dependencies and risk, and enabling predictable, high‑quality outcomes across multiple services and functional areas.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead the planning and delivery of complex technical programs, coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve measurable business and engineering outcomes.
* Translate strategic objectives and product requirements into integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, and execution priorities.
* Drive program-level technical alignment across engineering, product, design, and partner teams, supporting decisions related to system design, APIs, data, and delivery approaches.
* Manage risks, issues, dependencies, and trade-offs across multiple workstreams, using data and operational insights to improve predictability and execution quality.
* Establish governance, communication, reporting, and operating mechanisms that enable transparent decision-making and reliable delivery across technical domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve program, product, and engineering outcomes, applying foundational AI/ML concepts to real-world products and workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, product development, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience owning complex programs or portfolios involving multiple teams, services, or technical domains from planning through delivery and operational support.
* Technical proficiency in software development lifecycles, system design concepts, APIs, data models, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional execution, resolve risks and dependencies, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and make data-informed decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering complex, multi-service technical programs at scale with a strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, security, and customer outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams or domains without direct authority.
* Experience establishing metrics, dashboards, and feedback mechanisms to diagnose execution challenges and improve program predictability and delivery performance.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted program and engineering tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, delivery workflows, risk management, or business outcomes.
* Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled initiatives across technical programs, with appropriate attention to reliability, governance, and measurable impact.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

bdcd0a9e.title: Solutions Engineer
bdcd0a9e.description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Solutions Engineer
  
  
Location: Remote Or Hybrid / Office
  
  
Job ID: 49282**
**Profile Summary**
HID Global’s Biometric Identity Technologies division is seeking a skilled Solutions Engineer with a strong presales orientation, capable of delivering compelling demonstrations, managing strategic tenders, and guiding customers—particularly national authorities such as Police forces, Ministries, and other government institutions—through complex solution evaluations.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales to understand customer challenges, shape technical requirements, and identify opportunities for HID’s hardware, software, and professional services. While a solid architecture and development foundation is required, the emphasis is on customer-facing activities, including presentations, proof‑of‑concepts, and presales technical leadership.
  
  
You will help articulate HID Global’s value, support technical aspects of the sales cycle, and ensure smooth transitions from presales engagement into project execution. The position is designed for a motivated professional who excels in remote/hybrid environments and thrives in a role that blends technical expertise with high-impact communication.
  
  
You will support Sales across Middle East and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
  
  
**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Proven experience designing end-to-end identity verification, biometric enrollment, adjudication, or credentialing workflows involving sensitive biometric and personally identifiable information (PII).
* Experience creating solution architectures for large government agencies involving identity management, biometric matching, data integration, case management, or digital identity platforms.
* Proven experience working on AADHAR and related projects for biometric identity solutions (such as STQC, MOSIP, etc…)

**Who are we?**
HID Global Biometric Identity Technologies is trusted by governments and enterprises worldwide. We support everyday identity verification use cases where performance, accuracy and continuity are non-negotiable. HID Global’s mission is to power the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities include the following.**
Other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Serve as a technical presales expert within the Sales team, strengthening customer engagements through tailored demonstrations, technical guidance, and structured tender support.
* Develop and deliver high-impact solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and presentations that clearly communicate HID Global’s value to government and enterprise customers.
* Prepare detailed proposals and tender documentation for complex opportunities, ensuring compliance with government procurement requirements and alignment with customer technical needs.
* Interpret and refine customer requirements in collaboration with regional Sales, Product Management, and Engineering teams, ensuring proposed solutions address national authority use cases such as law enforcement, civil ID, and border management.
* Provide complete technical content for RFPs, RFIs, and government tenders, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and clarity.
* Architect, validate, and document biometric and identity‑management solutions across HID’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with mission‑critical government environments.
* Act as HID Global’s primary technical liaison throughout presales and post-sales phases, ensuring consistent communication, clarity on deliverables, and alignment between customer expectations and internal teams.
* Maintain deep awareness of market trends, biometric technologies, and public-sector digital transformation initiatives.
* Represent HID Global's technical capabilities at trade shows, partner events, and government briefings, delivering professional demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.

**Primary Duties:**

* Collaborate weekly with an international presales and solutions engineering team, sharing best practices and supporting cross-regional opportunities.
* Support Sales across Middle East, and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
* Focus on presales activities for HID’s commercial and ABIS solutions, especially for small-to-medium national authorities, civil registry agencies, and security ministries.

**Essential Qualifications (Required)**
To perform this role successfully, candidates must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Fluent in English and Hindi
* Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems or related fields
* Minimum 5 years of presales and customer-facing technical experience, including demonstrations, requirements analysis, and support
* Proven experience engaging with national authorities, such as Police agencies, Ministries of Interior/Justice, civil ID programs, or similar public-sector clients.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with a focus on server / client solution architecture
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, particularly for non-technical and government audiences
* Strong problem-solving aptitude with an ability to engineer customer-centric solutions that drive sales success
* Deep understanding of the hardware and software development lifecycle and technical solution delivery
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several presales engagements simultaneously in a hybrid/remote environment

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications
* Experience drafting Statements of Work and technical proposals
* Experience of working as a liaison between Sales and an Engineering team
* Able to manage technical solutions by performing basic project management functions including but not limited to scope, tracking deliverables, providing meeting minutes and tracking action items
* Experience with scripting or programming languages for adapting or creating demo environments
* Hands-on experience with development platforms or compilers (Android Studio, Visual Studio, etc.)
* Proven ability to configure, test, and validate server/client systems
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Familiarity with biometric systems (fingerprint, facial)
* Familiarity with document validation and proofing technologies for Passports or national IDs
* Experience with Enterprise and distributed system architecture
* Experience with collaboration and productivity tools: Salesforce, Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Git
* Strong teamwork abilities and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Solid experience working within an MS Windows 11 environment

**Why apply?**

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

95ea8928.title: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
95ea8928.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!
  
  
Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.
  
  
Job Description: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
  
  
We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 15 years of experience in Building Management Systems (BMS) and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS). The candidate must have an Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
  
  
This role will be based in India, providing pre-sales engineering support to regional teams, with close collaboration with local country experts for site-specific, regulatory, and commercial inputs.
  
  
The role of a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer involves the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Conducting both preliminary and detailed pre-sales engineering to assess project suitability, understand requirements, and quantify scope for BMS and Fire Alarm tenders, including service, retrofit (A&A), and system migration projects
* Reviewing tender documents, site information, and available as-built drawings to identify system requirements, HVAC equipment, fire alarm systems, field devices, and interface points
* Reviewing sequence of operations and fire cause & effect, identifying gaps in specifications related to I/O summary and system requirements
* Preparing key deliverables such as RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, loop/device schedules, and bills of material, including:
* Selection and sizing of BMS devices (sensors, valves, actuators, controllers)
* Selection and configuration of fire alarm systems (detectors, modules, panels – e.g., Sinteso EN)
* Definition of system interfaces and licenses
* Developing BMS and Fire system architecture, including integration with existing and third-party systems
* Producing technical compliance statements aligned with project specifications
* Working closely with local country experts to:
* Validate local fire code and regulatory compliance
* Incorporate actual site conditions and operational constraints
* Define scope boundaries and interfaces with other systems
* Supporting cost development by:
* Structuring and defining scope packages for subcontractors and suppliers
* Working with local teams, who will engage subcontractors and obtain budgetary quotations for relevant portions of the works
* Consolidating technical scope and cost inputs into the overall solution
* Recognising that supplier and subcontractor coordination, including quotation requests and commercial engagement, will be led by local country teams
* Identifying and mitigating technical and operational risks (e.g., legacy systems, live environment constraints), while capturing opportunities during tendering
* Preparing accurate project cost estimates, considering site constraints, phasing, and migration strategy
* Performing thorough quality checks on all deliverables prior to submission

**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of BMS, HVAC (ACMV), Electrical systems, and Fire Alarm Systems
* Understanding of fire system design principles, including cause & effect, zoning, and fail-safe operation
* Ability to work in a regional support model, collaborating effectively with local teams responsible for site validation, authority compliance, and supplier coordination
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Understanding of basic instrumentation and control loops
* Ability to interpret single line diagrams, fire schematics, and floor plans (including incomplete as-built drawings)
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, M-Bus, KNX, and system integration interfaces
* Proficiency in MS Office, Bluebeam, and AutoCAD/Groundplan tools
* Knowledge of Revit and BIM will be an added advantage
* Additional knowledge in IT networking, cybersecurity, and industry compliance practices is advantageous
* Experience in service/retrofit environments or regional/global project support will be an added advantage.

This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
  
  
Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers #SL

You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
  
  
Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.

With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.

Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Want to be part of our story? Apply today!

**Solutions Architect**
, you will be the trusted advisor helping our customers unlock the ultimate value of Couchbase. **Job Title: EDA Solutions Architect / Technical Lead**

**Remote Job**

**Shift Time : 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly experienced EDA Solutions Architect / Technical Lead to support a global data center consolidation and infrastructure migration initiative focused on Electronic Design Automation (EDA) environments. This individual will play a critical role in assessing existing infrastructure, defining migration strategies, and developing technical execution plans for complex workload migrations across multiple international sites.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a project management position. The ideal candidate will have deep experience evaluating enterprise infrastructure, designing migration solutions, and guiding large-scale data center consolidations from assessment through execution.

**Responsibilities**

Lead technical assessments of existing EDA infrastructure and data center environments.

Evaluate compute, storage, network, and application dependencies to determine migration readiness.

Develop detailed infrastructure recommendations, including server, storage, and capacity requirements.

Create migration strategies and technical execution plans for workload consolidation initiatives.

Analyze data residency and regulatory requirements to determine which workloads and data must remain in-country versus those eligible for migration.

Partner with infrastructure, storage, network, and operations teams to support migration planning and execution.

Provide technical guidance throughout the migration lifecycle, from discovery and assessment through cutover and post-migration stabilization.

Support the consolidation of multiple EDA environments across sites in France and Italy.

Identify risks, dependencies, and technical constraints and recommend mitigation strategies.

Assist migration teams during implementation and provide architectural oversight as workloads transition to their target environments.

**Required Skills & Experience**

10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering, architecture, or data center operations.

Proven experience leading large-scale infrastructure migrations and data center consolidation projects.

Strong understanding of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure platforms.

Experience performing workload assessments and developing infrastructure sizing and capacity recommendations.

Ability to independently evaluate environments and produce actionable technical migration plans.

Experience coordinating with global infrastructure and operations teams.

Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.

Experience supporting **Electronic Design Automation (EDA)** environments is strongly preferred and considered the highest priority for this role.

Familiarity with EDA infrastructure requirements, workload characteristics, and associated compute and storage demands.

**Nice to Have Skills & Experience**

Experience supporting semiconductor, engineering, or high-performance computing environments.

Exposure to Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) environments is beneficial but secondary to EDA expertise.

Experience working in multinational environments with data sovereignty and regional compliance considerations.

* Experience supporting semiconductor, engineering, or high-performance computing environments.
* Exposure to Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) environments is beneficial but secondary to EDA expertise.
* Experience working in multinational environments with data sovereignty and regional compliance considerations.

The ideal consultant combines the mindset of an architect with the hands-on abilities of a senior infrastructure engineer. Experience supporting EDA workloads and infrastructure modernization initiatives is essential.

Leadership centres on service performance, workforce planning, governance and continuous improvement.

* Balance workload, resilience and service coverage across clusters.

404e275e.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
404e275e.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
  
  
The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
  
  

* Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.

* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.

GPU Cluster Deployment

○ Network and power connectivity preparation
  
  
○ Hardware staging and deployment logistics Cluster Validation & Performance Testing
  
  

* Coordinate cluster bring-up and validation activities including:

○ Monitoring and telemetry integration
  
  
○ Operational documentation and runbooks
  
  
○ Handover to operations teams

* Experience with GPU cluster deployments or high-performance computing environments
* Familiarity with GPU server architecture and distributed computing infrastructure
* Experience working with Infrastructure Solution Architects to define system architecture and hardware BOM
* Experience managing data center hardware deployments and system integration
* Ability to coordinate multi-vendor infrastructure projects across regions Preferred Qualifications
* Experience deploying large-scale AI infrastructure or GPU clusters
* Familiarity with:

○ InfiniBand / RoCE / high-speed Ethernet networking
  
  
○ GPU interconnect validation (P2P / RDMA)

* Experience with cluster validation and performance benchmarking

* Experience deploying liquid-cooled GPU clusters or high-power racks

* Drive optimization of SFDC configuration across objects workflows approvals and automation to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention for finance and accounting teams
* Lead design and implementation of SFDC Lightning components and modern user experiences that streamline daily tasks for business users and enable intuitive access to critical financial data
* Execute integration strategies between SFDC platforms and external core banking or finance systems to ensure accurate data synchronization and high integrity information flows across the enterprise
* Oversee technical impact analysis and solution design reviews for new business requirements to confirm that changes are aligned with architectural principles and do not compromise system stability
* Collaborate closely with finance and accounting stakeholders to translate domain requirements into well structured Salesforce and nCino capabilities that directly support key financial reporting and lending processes
* Guide teams on best practices for code quality configuration management and environment governance to maintain reliable deployments and reduce production incidents in hybrid work settings
* Develop reusable architectural patterns integration templates and design standards that accelerate delivery of new features while maintaining consistent quality across multiple Salesforce implementations
* Support performance tuning and scalability improvements for SFDC and nCino applications to handle growing transaction volumes and complex financial products without degradation in user experience
* Coordinate with information security and compliance teams to embed regulatory controls audit readiness and secure data handling into every architectural decision impacting financial information
* Provide day shift technical oversight and issue resolution for critical incidents in Salesforce ecosystems ensuring minimal service disruption and timely restoration of business operations
* Document architectural decisions solution blueprints and technical roadmaps that help stakeholders understand system evolution and guide future investments in cloud based financial platforms

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive hands on experience in SFDC development and customization using Apex Visualforce and Lightning capabilities to deliver complex enterprise grade solutions
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in configuring SFDC objects workflows validation rules and automation features that support structured finance and accounting processes
* Show deep practical knowledge of SFDC Lightning design patterns and component based development that enables responsive and user friendly interfaces for business users
* Exhibit solid expertise in SFDC integration approaches including APIs and middleware based connectivity to seamlessly link Salesforce with core banking and financial systems
* Bring proven experience with nCino implementations that support lending onboarding and other financial product workflows within regulated environments

* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model using collaborative tools and clear communication to coordinate with distributed technical and business stakeholders

Salesforce Certified Application Architect Salesforce Platform Developer certification preferred nCino technical certification desirable

**Job Summary**

Sr Architect role responsible for designing and optimizing complex Siebel Loyalty and customer experience solutions for a global enterprise with a strong focus on Siebel EAI workflows Open UI eScripting and Siebel Loyalty Management. The role involves hybrid work model day shift collaboration with cross functional teams to deliver scalable architectures that enhance airline loyalty operations improve customer engagement and support long term business transformation.

* Design robust Siebel architectures that align enterprise strategy with scalable solutions focused on Siebel EAI workflows Open UI Loyalty Management and eScripting to support complex airline loyalty programs and customer interactions in a hybrid work environment.
* Oversee end to end solution design for loyalty program enrollment accrual redemption and partner integration by using Siebel EAI and workflow capabilities to ensure seamless customer journeys and accurate loyalty data processing.
* Provide detailed technical guidance on Siebel Open UI configurations to create intuitive accessible and responsive user interfaces that improve usability for operations teams and deliver consistent experiences for loyalty and airline service processes.
* Drive optimization of Siebel workflows by analyzing existing process flows identifying bottlenecks and implementing streamlined logic that increases system efficiency reduces manual intervention and enhances overall service reliability.
* Lead complex Siebel eScripting design and implementation to enable advanced business rules real time validations and automation that support sophisticated airline loyalty scenarios and improve operational accuracy.
* Coordinate integration of Siebel Loyalty Management with external airline systems and partner platforms by defining robust EAI messaging structures and error handling approaches to maintain data integrity across the ecosystem.
* Develop comprehensive technical design documents configuration standards and coding patterns that promote consistency maintainability and high performance across all Siebel components used in loyalty and airline processes.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders product owners and operations teams to translate loyalty and airline requirements into practical Siebel solutions that deliver measurable value for customers and the organization.
* Conduct detailed performance reviews and tuning activities on Siebel applications including evaluation of queries workflows and integration points to ensure the platform can scale with growing loyalty membership and transaction volumes.
* Guide environment planning and release strategies for Siebel updates and enhancements by coordinating with infrastructure and DevOps teams to ensure reliable deployments that minimize downtime and protect customer facing services.
* Mentor junior architects and senior engineers on Siebel best practices solution patterns and troubleshooting approaches to build a strong internal capability for sustaining and evolving loyalty and airline solutions.
* Partner with quality assurance teams to define test strategies data sets and automation coverage for Siebel EAI workflows Open UI and Loyalty Management so that releases achieve high functional and regression confidence.
* Engage with enterprise architecture and security teams to ensure Siebel solutions comply with governance standards data protection requirements and risk controls while still enabling innovation in loyalty offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience in Siebel EAI design and implementation including configuration of integration objects business services and complex data exchange scenarios that support airline loyalty and customer processes.
* Demonstrate deep practical expertise in Siebel Workflows by building debugging and optimizing multi step process flows that orchestrate loyalty transactions customer service activities and back office operations.

* Communicate clearly in hybrid work settings by engaging effectively in remote and onsite collaboration documenting decisions and ensuring alignment among technical and business stakeholders in day shift operations.
* Apply architectural thinking and structured design methods to evaluate tradeoffs in performance maintainability and flexibility ensuring Siebel solutions remain adaptable to evolving loyalty and airline business needs.
* Embrace collaborative ways of working with cross functional teams including data digital operations and partner management groups so that Siebel capabilities are leveraged strategically across the organization.

Preferred certifications include Oracle Siebel CRM certification and airline or loyalty focused professional credentials relevant to customer experience solutions.
