415a4e47.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive and Manufacturing, AWS Industries
415a4e47.description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Be great fun to work with.
  
  
At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
  
  
Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
* Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
* Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
* Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.
* Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
* Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
* Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience in IoT, Automotive or Manufacturing domain

021ad789.title: Sr. Technical Architect
021ad789.description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
  
  
**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Sr. Technical Architect, PS
  
  
**Locations:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Reports to**
: Director, Professional Services
  
  
**A quick snapshot…**
Conga is seeking an experienced Technical Architect with over 12+ years of work experience who will play a key role in implementing Quote-to-Cash suite of products, including CPQ (configure/price/quote), contract management, revenue management and other related solutions. Perform hands-on design, solution architectures, architecture roadmaps, prototyping, proof-of-concepts, development tasks and integrating Conga products as required in support of current and new projects. Ensuring the solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements. Working with global teams actively for implementation. Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Leading technical teams to deliver flexible and scalable solutions.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
A Technical Architect will help us design and deliver solutions for enterprise-grade customers using Conga products. The intention is to recommend the best solution for a given set of requirements and articulate the trade-offs involved in choosing one solution over another. Leading design sessions and writing design documents by managing the delivery of integrations and custom extensions will be most critical. This person should also be highly proficient and successful in managing the technical and overall scope of the client’s expectations.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
You should understand business requirements regarding product management and develop solution design and enhancements using different configurations, using Salesforce or Dot Net platform (APEX, Visual Force, C#, Angular / React JS or equivalent front-end technologies). Thorough unit testing with a high level of code coverage is necessary. You should have demonstrated experience of working as part of an Agile development team. Experience automated deployment process will help score more.
  
  
**Implementation and Integrations.**
The ability to drive deep-level technical discussions with prospects and help set expectations for potential project efforts is a must. A Technical Architect would interact directly with clients and end-users on a regular basis to analyze project objectives and capability requirements, including specifications for user interfaces, customized applications, and interactions with internal / external applications.
  
  
**Design and Pre-Sales Activities.**
You would be responsible for providing hands-on expert level assistance to developers for any issues. Designing and managing the execution deployment and testing ensuring a quality solution is delivered will be the key. Ability to lead a requirement gathering session, write requirements, architecture documents and manage integrations. This role will include participation in pre-sales activities as and when required.
  
  
**Education**
. A bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Champion of the Customer**
. You understand that customers are one of business’ most important assets and you take that seriously. With more than 11,000 customers around the globe entrusting Conga with their business we make a commitment to their success and would love to hear how you will too!
  
  
**Analytical thinker and creative problem solver.**
You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter - a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs.
  
  
**Quality oriented**
. You rarely make mistakes because you have good processes in place to ensure that every detail is correct. But in those rare occasions when errors are realized (let’s face it, it happens to the best of us from time to time), you own them, correct them, learn from them, and then quickly adjust and communicate processes to ensure the same mistake doesn’t happen twice. It’s your transparency, authenticity and humility are what sets you apart from the rest
  
  
**Tools and certifications.**
Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Working experience with Atlassian Suite. Salesforce Platform Developer certifications (level I and II are preferred) or Microsoft Solutions Developer (MCSD) / Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
  
  
**Industry expertise.**
Let’s face it, understanding of the software as a service industry would allow you to hit the ground running.
  
  
**Did we pique your interest?**
If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Preferred Resume Format**
We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
  
  
**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?**


Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

208a7349.title: AWS Cloud Solution Architect
208a7349.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in cloud architecture, Azure services, Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud networking, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role requires a combination of technical leadership, hands-on architecture experience, stakeholder management, and delivery excellence to build scalable, secure, and business-aligned cloud solutions.
  
  

* Role: AWS Cloud Solution Architect
* Location: Pune
* Experience: Between 12 to 15 Years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement scalable, secure, highly available, and resilient cloud solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Lead technical discovery workshops and architecture assessments for cloud transformation initiatives.
* Define target-state architectures, cloud adoption roadmaps, integration patterns, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate technology options and recommend cloud-native and hybrid-cloud solutions.
* Design and implement infrastructure automation solutions using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.
* Guide engineering teams through cloud migrations, modernization initiatives, deployments, testing, and production readiness activities.
* Collaborate with product, security, infrastructure, data, and delivery teams to address dependencies, risks, and technical challenges.
* Define cloud networking strategies, connectivity models, and security architectures.
* Drive governance, compliance, reliability, observability, performance optimization, and cost management initiatives.
* Support CI/CD implementation and cloud automation best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, and solution validation exercises.
* Establish cloud security controls and ensure alignment with enterprise security standards.
* Mentor development and cloud engineering teams to promote best practices, reusable patterns, and engineering excellence.
* Communicate complex technical solutions effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 12-15 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in cloud architecture and enterprise solution design.
* Strong expertise in Cloud Solution Architecture, Azure, Terraform, and Cloud Networking.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade cloud platforms with built-in security, scalability, availability, and maintainability.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of cloud networking, connectivity, security, and hybrid architecture patterns.
* Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and transformation programs.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of cloud governance, compliance, security, and operational best practices.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof-of-concepts, and design governance activities.
* Expertise in stakeholder management, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, documentation, mentoring, and presentation skills.
* Experience driving continuous improvement and engineering quality initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers**

1cc3abc0.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
1cc3abc0.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra

86f0e742.description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Cloud Engineering Manager – API**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Engineering Manager – API, Full Stack & AI/ML with 12+ years of strong experience in cloud engineering, enterprise application development, API-led architecture, Full Stack development, and AI/ML solution delivery across multi-cloud environments. The role focuses on leading the design, development, and modernization of cloud-native applications, enterprise API ecosystems, and AI-powered business solutions to drive digital transformation, innovation, and operational excellence for enterprise clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise combined with strong consulting and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to lead large engineering teams, define technology roadmaps, drive AI/ML adoption, and deliver scalable cloud and API solutions across complex enterprise landscapes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and modernization of cloud-native applications, enterprise API platforms, and AI-powered solutions across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Define and execute API-first, cloud-native, and platform engineering strategies aligned with enterprise digital transformation objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, governance frameworks, architecture best practices, and reusable technology accelerators across application development initiatives.
* Drive adoption of modern application architectures including microservices, event-driven systems, containerized platforms, and serverless technologies.
* Lead full-stack application development using modern frontend and backend frameworks with Python as the primary development language.
* Strong competency in enterprise API design, development, integration, lifecycle management, security, and governance using API Management platforms.
* Drive implementation of enterprise integration solutions leveraging REST APIs, GraphQL, event streaming, and hybrid cloud integration patterns.
* Lead development and operationalization of AI/ML, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, AI Agents, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Collaborate with data science, cloud, platform, and business teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business processes.
* Define AI engineering best practices including Responsible AI, MLOps, security, observability, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Drive cloud application modernization initiatives utilizing Kubernetes, Containers, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Lead Proof of Concepts (PoCs), innovation initiatives, solution accelerators, and technology assessments for Cloud, API, and AI transformation programs.
* Develop business cases, executive dashboards, technology roadmaps, and solution recommendations for client engagements.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, DevOps, and Platform teams to align technology initiatives with enterprise governance and operational objectives.
* Support pre-sales opportunities, solutioning workshops, RFP responses, technical proposals, and strategic consulting engagements.

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Application Development, API Engineering, Full Stack Development, and Technology Delivery.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, architecture programs, and large-scale cloud transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture principles including microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Proven expertise in API strategy, API governance, integration architecture, and enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience leading AI/ML and Generative AI solution development and enterprise adoption programs.
* Experience working in client-facing consulting, advisory, or enterprise transformation roles.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, application security, governance, compliance, DevSecOps, and operational excellence practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong expertise in Cloud Platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Deep hands-on experience in Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django, and backend service development.
* Strong Full Stack development expertise using React.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Strong competency in designing and implementing REST APIs, GraphQL services, Microservices, and Enterprise Integration frameworks.
* Experience with API Management platforms including Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, MuleSoft, or equivalent solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Event-Driven Architecture, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and enterprise messaging platforms.
* Proven expertise in AI/ML technologies including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and MLOps.
* Strong competency in developing solutions using LLMs, RAG Architectures, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, and Vector Databases.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Redis, Pinecone, ChromaDB, and FAISS.
* Strong understanding of Observability, Application Performance Monitoring, Logging, Security Monitoring, and Site Reliability Engineering practices.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

bf66839c.title: Technical Solutions Consultant
bf66839c.description:
**Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant**
*GCC India | TreadNet and B2B Platform Support*
**Position Summary**
The Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant provides advanced customer and technical support for TreadNet and related B2B platforms. Based in the Bridgestone GCC India office, this role serves internal users and external customers across the United States and Canada, resolving complex access, functional, and technical issues that cannot be resolved through Tier 1 support. The consultant combines strong troubleshooting capability with clear, professional customer communication and owns issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  
  
This role is customer-facing and requires confident verbal and written English communication, including the ability to lead calls, communicate technical issues in business-friendly language, and build trust with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality Tier 2 support to internal users and external B2B customers across the United States and Canada.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated issues involving TreadNet, supporting systems, user access, browser behavior, integrations, and functional workflows.
* Support user provisioning and access management in accordance with established user-management controls and procedures.
* Engage customers by phone, email, chat, and video conference to gather details, troubleshoot issues, communicate status, and confirm resolution.
* Provide technical assistance for common issues, including password resets, browser and cache clearing, account access, and basic platform navigation.
* Provide user guidance and basic training on TreadNet and supporting-system functionality.
* Follow established Incident Management, Problem Management, knowledge-management, and escalation processes.
* Document incidents accurately, including issue details, troubleshooting performed, customer communication, root cause where known, and resolution steps.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to Tier 3, Product, Engineering, Platform, or vendor teams; track progress through closure and keep customers informed.
* Identify recurring incident patterns, customer pain points, and enhancement opportunities; document and route feedback through established processes.
* Contribute to and maintain support guides, knowledge articles, troubleshooting playbooks, user instructions, and training materials.
* Participate in support triage, operational reviews, and continuous-improvement activities to improve service quality, resolution time, and customer experience.
* Maintain awareness of service-level expectations and support team metrics, including response time, resolution time, ticket quality, and backlog aging.

**Shift Coverage and Work Schedule**
The Tier 2 GCC India support team will provide coverage for the U.S. business day from 6:00 AM Central Time through 8:00 PM Central Time (UTC -6). Coverage will be split between two consultants, with planned overlap to support handoffs, triage, collaboration, and peak customer demand. Candidates must be willing and able to work assigned India-based shifts that align to this U.S. coverage window, including overlap hours as required.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least 4 years of experience in technical support, application support, service desk, customer support, or a related technology-support role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues methodically, ask effective diagnostic questions, and explain solutions clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Experience managing incidents and escalations through ticketing systems and following issues through to resolution.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic, problem-solving, time-management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused, deadline-oriented environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively within a distributed team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; ability to create clear support documentation.

0bd212c7.title: Service Delivery Manager
0bd212c7.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for establishing, operating, and continuously improving Service Level Management for the assigned SAP and ERP application services. The role ensures reliable service delivery, effective lifecycle management, compliance, security, and ongoing alignment with business requirements.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with business stakeholders, internal technology teams, SAP functional teams, infrastructure teams, and external service providers to design sustainable solutions, manage service performance, and drive continuous improvement across the SAP application landscape. The role includes ownership of service governance, vendor performance, service reporting, incident and problem management, application lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SAP Application and Functional Service Management**

* Manage the end-to-end service delivery of SAP applications and related ERP services.
* Work with business stakeholders and SAP functional teams to understand business requirements, service expectations, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure that SAP services are designed, transitioned, operated, and retired in line with established service management processes.
* Coordinate SAP application enhancements, releases, upgrades, maintenance activities, and improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate integration between SAP applications and connected systems, platforms, and business processes.
* Support the successful transition of new or enhanced SAP solutions into production with minimal business disruption.
* Ensure operational readiness, including support documentation, monitoring, knowledge transfer, support models, and formal handover.
* Monitor application availability, performance, capacity, stability, adoption, and user satisfaction.

**Service Level and Performance Management**

* Establish and manage Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements, and related service targets.
* Define meaningful service performance indicators and ensure that agreed KPIs are measured and reported consistently.
* Lead periodic service reviews with business stakeholders, internal teams, and strategic service providers.
* Prepare and deliver service performance reports, management dashboards, annual service reviews, and improvement plans.
* Identify service gaps, agree corrective actions, and track improvement initiatives through to completion.
* Ensure that service-related information is maintained accurately in relevant repositories and IT service management tools, such as ServiceNow, CMDB, monitoring platforms, and reporting solutions.
* Drive consistent implementation of the service management framework across the assigned SAP service portfolio.

**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**

* Ensure effective management of major incidents, recurring incidents, problems, and service requests.
* Coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive actions, and post-incident reviews.
* Track application outages, downtime, service interruptions, and business impact.
* Ensure that changes to SAP applications are assessed, approved, communicated, tested, and implemented in accordance with change management procedures.
* Work with relevant teams to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.
* Support automation and process optimisation opportunities across service management and SAP operations.

**Vendor and Partner Management**

* Manage the operational performance of SAP service providers and strategic partners.
* Review vendor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality targets, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely delivery of service reports, improvement plans, corrective actions, and annual service reviews.
* Facilitate governance meetings and maintain clear escalation and communication paths.
* Ensure that suppliers meet applicable security, quality, compliance, and service management expectations.

**Compliance, Risk, and Business Continuity**

* Ensure that SAP services comply with applicable internal policies and external requirements, including security, vulnerability management, data protection, licensing, GxP, and GDPR obligations, where relevant.
* Support risk identification, mitigation planning, audit readiness, and compliance reporting.
* Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery and business continuity plans for the assigned SAP applications.
* Plan, coordinate, and document Disaster Recovery tests and follow up on identified actions.
* Ensure that service operations support business continuity and minimise disruption to critical business processes.

**SAP Functional Background**
A good understanding of SAP functional processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with SAP business process owners and functional consultants is required.
  
  
Experience in
**two or more of the following SAP functional modules**
will be considered an added advantage:
  
  

* SAP FI – Financial Accounting
* SAP CO – Controlling
* SAP MM – Materials Management
* SAP SD – Sales and Distribution
* SAP PP – Production Planning
* SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
* SAP QM – Quality Management
* SAP PS – Project System
* SAP WM / EWM – Warehouse Management / Extended Warehouse Management
* SAP Ariba – Procurement and Supplier Management

**Education And Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in software services, application management, ERP operations, or IT service delivery.
* At least 5 years of experience working in an international or globally distributed environment.
* Experience managing SAP applications, enterprise platforms, or complex business-critical application services.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders, business teams, technology functions, and external service providers.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience is required.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of IT service management principles, particularly Service Level Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Capacity Management, and Service Continuity Management.
* Practical understanding of SAP application landscapes, functional processes, integrations, and operational dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into sustainable service and application management solutions.
* Strong capability to develop concepts, establish governance models, and drive pragmatic implementation.
* Experience with service performance management, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, CMDBs, monitoring solutions, ticketing systems, and service repositories.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, escalation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of information security, risk management, data protection, quality standards, and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, international, and matrixed environment.
* Proactive approach to automation, standardisation, service improvement, and operational excellence.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

ae31cb4e.title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Service Desk
ae31cb4e.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – HR Service Desk**

*Global Process Owner, HR Service Desk & Case Management (Q2R)*

**Tower**

Query to Resolution (Q2R)

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Multi-channel HR contact centre (Tier 0–2), case management, knowledge management and employee self-service

  

**Grade**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the front door of HR. You will turn country help desks, shared inboxes and informal routes into one tiered, multilingual service desk. Employees will get fast, accurate answers, and every query will be tracked, measured and used to improve how HR works.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map each country's current query channels, volumes, query types and resolution paths, and set the baseline.
* Design the Q2R tiered model: Tier 0 self-service and chatbot, Tier 1 hub desk, Tier 2 hub specialists, and Tier 3 CoE or country HR, with clear handoff rules.
* Set up the service desk for each transition wave, covering language coverage, time-zone rostering, channel setup and routing rules.
* Build the knowledge base before each go-live so that every in-scope query type has approved content from day one.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for Q2R. Own case categorisation, priority and SLA matrices, and escalation paths.
* Own the central knowledge base and keep it current. Target 95%+ coverage of Tier 1 queries and track content accuracy.
* Run weekly triage and trend reviews with HR business partners and GPOs. Turn repeat queries into process fixes in other towers.
* Plan workforce needs using volume forecasting and real-time management to meet service levels.
* Handle sensitive and VIP cases with discretion. Apply clear routing for ER, grievance and wellbeing matters.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Run a quality assurance framework covering random case audits, calibration sessions, customer-feedback sampling and SLA scoring.
* Enforce data-privacy controls on case content, access and retention.
* Maintain a service catalogue and SLA agreements with each receiving country and CoE.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Increase self-service and chatbot deflection through better content and design.
* Use case and sentiment analytics to find the top drivers of contact and remove them at source.
* Deploy generative-AI agent assist and knowledge tools, with human quality control.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: tier model, service catalogue, and case taxonomy with SLA matrix signed off.
* By go-live: service desk live for the first wave, with the knowledge base and QA framework running.
* Within 12–18 months: rising self-service deflection, FCR and CSAT at target, and falling repeat contacts.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**First contact resolution**

* 75% at Tier 1

  

**Employee CSAT**

* 4.3 / 5

  

**SLA adherence (response and resolution)**

* 95%

  

**Self-service / chatbot deflection**

Increased quarter on quarter

  

**Knowledge base coverage**

* 95% of Tier 1 query types

  

**QA score**

* 90%

  

**Repeat contact rate**

Reduced against baseline

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* HR service delivery and case management platforms (ServiceNow HRSD, Salesforce, Workday Help or similar, preferably Zendesk).
* Knowledge management covering content governance, article lifecycle and search optimisation.
* Contact-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, real-time management and multi-channel routing.
* ITIL v4 service management practices.
* Quality assurance and speech/text analytics.
* Conversational AI and chatbot design.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR or employee services, including 7+ years leading a multi-country HR service desk.
* Has set up or transitioned an HR contact centre into shared services.
* Has led multilingual, multi-time-zone service operations.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher
* COPC or similar contact-centre certification
* Experience implementing Zendesk HRSD

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, other tower GPOs, HR business partners, CoEs, country HR, HR technology team, employee representatives where relevant.

* 95%

* 98%

Year-on-year reduction

No high-rated findings

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR, including 7+ years leading HR administration in shared services.
* Has led the transition and standardisation of lifecycle processes across several countries.

Hub Director, R2P and R2H GPOs, HR business partners, country HR, HRIS team, Legal and Data Privacy, IT.

**Indicative target**

100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

* 98% against contracted SLAs

Year-on-year reduction against baseline

No high-rated findings

b91b360f.title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
b91b360f.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – Performance & Continuous Improvement**

*Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead – all towers*

**Tower**

Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

  

**Grade**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.
* Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point.
* Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave.
* Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W.
* Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight.
* Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers.
* Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions.
* Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.
* Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings.
* Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.
* Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off.
* By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running.
* Within 12–18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Hub-wide SLA adherence**

* 95% across towers

  

**Validated CI benefits**

Annual savings and hours released against target

  

**Automation hours released**

Increased year on year

  

**Reporting timeliness and accuracy**

100% on schedule

  

**Hub CSAT / NPS**

At or above target

  

**Audit and quality findings**

Closed within agreed timelines

  

**CI participation**

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services.
* Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis.
* Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage.
* Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI).
* ITIL service level management and quality management systems.
* Benefits realisation and business case development.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles.
* Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function.
* Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Transition PMO experience
* Process mining certification
* Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

350f2363.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
350f2363.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

0adeef54.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ordering
0adeef54.description:
**Description**
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make the purchase experience across online retail seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by technology, passionate about learning, must think big, translate complex technical concepts into actionable solutions, lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact prototypes, and maintain regular stakeholder communications through structured reporting and updates.
  
  
You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment. You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive the SDLC process end-to-end through structured mechanisms from ideation to launch of product features and post launch tracking of adoption and business metrics improvements
* Collaborate with wider stakeholders to identify customer pain points and influence the product and delivery roadmap to address the same.
* Inspect & adapt the delivery processes to bring continuous improvements in quality and speed.
* Share knowledge and best practices within and across SWA teams
* Driving technical programs related to invoicing/billing customers for the logistics services that Amazon Shipping provides to them, and the subsequent process around the collection management of the payments received from our customers will be one of the key area of responsibility

**About The Team**
Ordering stands at the heart of Amazon retail, guiding the journey from purchase to delivery to resolution. We started Ordering India site in 2025 and we are growing this team incrementally. This team will play a pivotal role in evolution of Ordering charter. Our team works on large programs cutting across multiple partner teams, production-scale systems handling billions of transactions across all Amazon worldwise marketplaces, coming up with innovative designs to help continuously make our platform ready for our current and future challenges.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience in FinTech domain with UPI, digital wallets, cards , driving programs involving Billing and Payment flows (Accounts Payable, Account Receivable) and having interface with accounting, tax systems, Ledger systems, is highly desired

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

5e105780.title: Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency
5e105780.description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is looking for a Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency to provide end-to-end oversight of these initiatives: maintain the portfolio, set priorities, drive the operating cadence, unblock owners, and ensure savings land. Glean delivers AI at enterprise scale across a deliberately open, provider-neutral stack. This breadth necessitates numerous efficiency initiatives running in parallel across engineering — token yield, compute right-sizing, LLM Gateway quotas, provider commitments to name a few.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive Cloud and AI/LLM efficiency
* Own a single, prioritised source of truth for all cost initiatives and drive them to measurable efficiency and margin gains.
* Pressure-test savings claims: verify realised vs. projected savings post-launch, and prevent silent cost regressions from eroding prior wins
* Build cost-attribution discipline: per-service, per-team, per-customer, per-feature tagging and allocation so every dollar has an owner
* Oversee LLM spend across providers: procurement and commitment sizing
* Govern internal AI tooling spend with per-user visibility, quotas, and value assessment
* Build the observability & automation layer
* Treat cost like production telemetry: real-time cost attribution, anomaly detection, alerting, and automated triage
* Automate the toil: cost-triage agents, regression detection, and self-serve attribution so the program scales

**About You**

* Deep, hands-on understanding of cloud infrastructure and AI/LLM economics
* Proficient in driving efficiency, capacity, or FinOps-adjacent programs
* Eng operations instincts: you think in SLOs, error budgets, telemetry, and postmortems, and you apply that discipline to spend

**Location:**

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**
