21d77d2e.title: Technical Program Manager
21d77d2e.description:
Position: Technical Program Manager  
  
Location: Remote  
  
Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to drive the planning, coordination and successful delivery of complex technology programs across our AI-powered SaaS platforms in the RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance and Financial Reporting domains.  
  
The role requires a strong technical background combined with excellent program management, execution, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills. You will work closely with Engineering, DevOps and Business teams to translate product strategy into executable technical programs, manage dependencies, track milestones, mitigate risks and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.  
  
You will serve as a bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, ensuring alignment across teams, visibility into program progress and timely resolution of technical and operational challenges. A solid understanding of modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs and AI/LLM-based applications is essential to effectively manage technically complex initiatives.  
  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Technical Program Management & Delivery  
  
Own end-to-end planning, coordination, execution and delivery of multiple technical programs and cross-functional initiatives.  
Translate business requirements and product roadmaps into program plans, milestones, deliverables, timelines and measurable outcomes.  
Coordinate with Engineering, DevOps and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on scope, priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.  
Establish program governance, execution tracking, reporting mechanisms and regular review cadences.  
Monitor program progress against timelines, budgets, scope, quality standards and business objectives.  
Identify delivery bottlenecks, proactively resolve blockers and drive decisions to keep programs on track.  
Manage scope changes, competing priorities, resource constraints and cross-team dependencies.  
Drive Agile/Scrum execution, sprint coordination, release planning and continuous improvement in delivery processes.  
2. Technical Leadership & Architecture Coordination  
  
Work closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand solution designs, technical dependencies, implementation approaches and delivery risks.  
Facilitate technical discussions, architecture reviews, design decisions and cross-team alignment.  
Evaluate technical trade-offs involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability, integration complexity and time to market.  
Ensure technical decisions align with product objectives, architectural standards and long-term platform strategy.  
Coordinate initiatives involving microservices, APIs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, data processing and enterprise integrations.  
Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation plans in collaboration with engineering teams.  
Provide technical guidance and challenge assumptions where required without becoming the primary owner of day-to-day coding or people management.  
3. AI, Automation & Innovation Programs  
  
Drive the planning and delivery of AI-powered product initiatives involving LLMs, generative AI, NLP and intelligent workflow automation.  
Coordinate implementation of AI capabilities such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document intelligence, structured output generation, data extraction and automated validation.  
Work with engineering and product teams to define technical milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies and success metrics for AI initiatives.  
Ensure AI implementations address accuracy, reliability, performance, data privacy, security, explainability and operational requirements.  
Track model and provider integrations, evaluation activities, deployment readiness and production adoption.  
Facilitate the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that improve product capabilities, engineering efficiency and business outcomes.  
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication  
  
Act as the primary coordination point between technical teams, product leadership, business stakeholders and senior management for assigned programs.  
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, resource requirements and delivery forecasts through clear and actionable reporting.  
Set expectations with stakeholders regarding timelines, scope, technical constraints and trade-offs.  
Facilitate program reviews, steering meetings, retrospectives and escalation discussions.  
Ensure business requirements are translated into clear technical deliverables and that engineering outcomes meet stakeholder expectations.  
Drive alignment across distributed teams and ensure accountability for commitments and decisions.  
5. Risk, Quality & Release Management  
  
Maintain program-level risk, assumption, issue and dependency tracking, with clear ownership and mitigation plans.  
Establish appropriate quality gates, acceptance criteria, testing milestones and release-readiness processes.  
Coordinate integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, security assessments and production releases.  
Track critical defects, technical debt, operational concerns and unresolved issues that may affect delivery or product reliability.  
Ensure delivery processes support security, compliance, auditability and enterprise customer requirements.  
Conduct post-release reviews and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

6. Process Improvement & Program Metrics  
  
Define and track meaningful delivery metrics, including milestone adherence, predictability, lead time, defect trends, dependency resolution and release quality.  
Improve planning, estimation, prioritization, resource coordination and cross-team execution practices.  
Standardize program documentation, decision logs, status reporting and escalation processes.  
Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, delivery efficiency and collaboration.  
Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.  
Required Skills & Experience  
  
10+ years of overall experience in software development, technical delivery, engineering or technology program management.  
5+ years of experience managing complex technical projects or programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.  
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum methodologies, release management and program governance.  
Proven track record of delivering complex technology initiatives within agreed timelines and quality expectations.  
Strong technical understanding of enterprise application architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.  
Experience managing dependencies, risks, competing priorities, scope changes and stakeholder expectations.  
Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills.  
Ability to engage effectively with both senior business stakeholders and hands-on engineering teams.  
Experience working with remote or geographically distributed teams.  
Technical Knowledge  
  
The candidate should have a strong working understanding of the following technologies and concepts:  
  
Backend: Node.js, Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.  
Frontend: Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.  
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.  
Containers & Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Linux environments.  
Architecture: REST APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS and distributed applications.  
Data & Storage: Relational databases, data modeling, caching, object storage and data integration patterns.  
Engineering Practices: Version control, code review processes, automated testing, observability and production release management.  
Note: This position requires technical fluency to guide and coordinate engineering delivery; expert hands-on proficiency in every technology is not mandatory.  
  
Preferred Experience  
  
Experience in Enterprise SaaS, FinTech, RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance or Financial Reporting platforms.  
Experience delivering regulatory reporting, disclosure management, financial data processing or audit-focused software.  
Familiarity with XBRL, iXBRL, regulatory taxonomies, validation workflows or structured reporting standards.  
Experience managing multi-team programs involving complex integrations, large datasets and enterprise customer requirements.  
Experience coordinating cloud migrations, platform modernization, system integrations or architecture transformations.  
Familiarity with information security, data privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise software delivery controls.  
AI & LLM Experience  
  
Experience managing or delivering AI-powered applications involving some of the following:  
  
Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP and generative AI.  
Prompt engineering and structured output generation.  
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and retrieval pipelines.  
LangChain and/or LlamaIndex.  
Vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB or Pinecone.  
Embeddings, semantic search and document intelligence.  
AI model evaluation, accuracy measurement and quality assurance.  
Integration with managed AI services and model providers.  
AI security, privacy, governance and responsible deployment practices.  
Tools & Delivery Practices  
  
Experience with program and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.  
Proficiency in maintaining roadmaps, delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers and executive status reports.  
Experience with Agile planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release coordination and cross-functional governance.  
Ability to define measurable outcomes and use delivery metrics to improve execution predictability

**Who You’ll Become**
A Solution Advisor works closely with our customers and prospects to identify and solve business challenges and meet their strategic objectives using SAP solutions. As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the “subject matter expert” responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP’s unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts.

As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to:

* Receive on-the-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey.

You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals

* 2-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer-facing skills.
* Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands-on experience using relevant technologies and industry-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency.
* A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
* A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
* An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
* Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
* Proficiency in English to engage with our global network.
* AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
* A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
* Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
* A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.

Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**

In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in cloud migration, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, CI/CD, and cloud security best practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on **GCP** and **AWS**.
* Build scalable, highly available, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using **Terraform**.
* Automate provisioning, deployment, and infrastructure management.
* Configure and manage cloud networking, storage, and compute services.
* Deploy and support containerized applications using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application deployment.
* Implement cloud monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Ensure cloud security, compliance, and governance standards are followed.
* Perform cloud infrastructure optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate with application, DevOps, and security teams for seamless cloud adoption.

Required Skills

* Strong experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and/or **AWS**.
* Hands-on experience with **Terraform** and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Knowledge of cloud networking, VPC, Load Balancers, DNS, VPN, and Security Groups.
* Experience in CI/CD tools such as **Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD**.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration.
* Experience with scripting using **Python, Shell Script, or Bash**.
* Knowledge of cloud monitoring and logging tools.
* Understanding of cloud security, IAM, and governance practices.
* Familiarity with automation and configuration management tools.

GCP Services Knowledge

* Compute Engine
* Cloud Storage
* GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine)
* Cloud SQL
* BigQuery
* VPC & Cloud Networking
* Cloud Monitoring & Logging

AWS Services Knowledge

* EC2
* S3
* EKS
* RDS
* Lambda
* CloudWatch
* IAM
* VPC

Good to Have

* Experience with Multi-Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of DevOps and SRE practices.
* Exposure to Serverless Architecture.
* Experience with Ansible and configuration management tools.
* Experience working in Agile environments.

Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure Management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud environments.

4f451f03.title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
4f451f03.description:
**Service Delivery Manager Performance & Continuous Improvement**

*Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead all towers*

  

**Tower:** Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

**Location:** Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:** HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:** People manager

**Scope:** Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

  

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.
* Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point.
* Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave.
* Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W.
* Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight.
* Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers.
* Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions.
* Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.
* Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings.
* Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.
* Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off.
* By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running.
* Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

  

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Hub-wide SLA adherence:**  95% across towers

**Validated CI benefits:** Annual savings and hours released against target

**Automation hours released:** Increased year on year

**Reporting timeliness and accuracy:** 100% on schedule

**Hub CSAT / NPS:** At or above target

**Audit and quality findings:** Closed within agreed timelines

**CI participation:** % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

  

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services.
* Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis.
* Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage.
* Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI).
* ITIL service level management and quality management systems.
* Benefits realisation and business case development.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Customer-centric leadership
* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

  

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles.
* Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function.
* Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Transition PMO experience
* Process mining certification
* Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

8f91d45d.title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
8f91d45d.description:
**Service Delivery Manager Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

  

**Tower:** Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:** Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:** HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:** People manager

**Scope:** Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

  

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

  

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**  99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:** 100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:** Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:** Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**  98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:** Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:** No high-rated findings

  

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

  

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

  

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Builds teams from zero
* Customer-centric leadership
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

  

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team, IT relevant.

You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

b0ae6a6d.description:
**Description**
*Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.*
The Technical Architect will support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. The Technical Architect will be responsible for successfully designing and building the Salesforce industry-specific Education Cloud solutions, particularly using Salesforce Education Cloud.
  
  
The Technical Architect maintains an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem. As a Technical Architect, you will become a deep product guide with Education Cloud applications, having strong focus on salesforce platform (e.g. Sales, Service, Community, and Einstein Clouds) and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working closely with Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects, and directly with clients and IT development staff to architect technology solutions to meet client needs and ensure the software product is leveraged correctly and the go-forward solution is easy to maintain and meets best practices. This includes a lead role in project discovery and definition workshops, contributing to creating scope and development estimates, and documenting requirements and designs.
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (sales/pre-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers maximize the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services.
* Designing transformational technology solutions and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry best practices.
* Leading and mentoring the development and QA teams on the project.
* Responsible for the application design, development, and support of Salesforce-related projects. The candidate must demonstrate progressive leadership in the full life cycle of the software development environment.
* Through the use of UML diagrams, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies; the candidate will be responsible for the detailed design of Salesforce-related projects from inception through production support.
* Responsible for ensuring that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business unit, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance requirements are closely monitored by working with the development teams.
* Responsible for creating, delivering, in a timely and accurate fashion, CRMs and workflow solutions using Salesforce/Apex, Visualforce, Lightning, LWC, and J2EE technologies.
* Advocate and implement best practice development methodology to drive quality delivery of enterprise solutions.
* Develop POCs or help customers and partners with complex coding tasks.
* Identify and lead internal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; contribute to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* Extensive experience and understanding of the Education Sector and the need for digital transformation.
* In-depth understanding of education cloud focus areas – Recruitment, Admission, Onboarding, Career Readiness and Alumni.
* Worked on education cloud project and implemented the student lifecycle journey
* 8+ years of experience working on deployment teams, ideally using Agile development techniques.
* Proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations for Education clients.
* Experience leading teams in the analysis of complex problems, and the design and implementation of related solutions.
* Salesforce.com integration experience, including between different business systems as well as working with integration tools.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, programming with APEX APIs, APEX Triggers, Apex classes, APEX Web services, API, AppExchange deployment and implementing new instances of Salesforce.com from scratch.
* Strong experience on Omnistudio suite, Business Rules Engine (BRE), Experience Cloud Integration
* Strong practical knowledge of Lightning, VisualForce, Flex, and LWC.
* Ability to define the system landscape, identify gaps between current and desired end-states, and deliver a CRM solution.
* Understanding of DevOps and Release Management for large-scale transformation projects.
* A self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground
* Excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal team members

**Technical Skills**

* In-depth knowledge of Education processes in industry-specific solutions (e.g. (Recruitment & Admissions, Academic Operations, Student lifecycle management, Alumni Operations etc)
* Strong knowledge of Education cloud Data model, Education customer journeys, and best practices
* DevOps and Release management
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Flows, Community, Lightning, LWC
* Familiarity with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others)

**DESIRED CERTIFICATIONS & QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field
* Certified in Education Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud
* Experience on Agentforce will be preferred
* Experience on Data Cloud will be preferred
* Familiar and using AI tools to bolster implementation productivity (e.g. Cursor, Claude, NotebookLM etc)

40e836d3.title: Gen AI GCP Architect - Senior Manager- Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad
40e836d3.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position: GCP AI Senior Manager**
**Department: Technology Consulting, D&A**
**Title: AI Architect (GenAI)**
**Educational qualification: BTech/Masters/PhD**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Manager – GenAI Architect with 14+ years of experience to own the end‑to‑end solution architecture of enterprise GenAI platforms. This role is heavily focused on solution design, PoC & MVP creation, architectural decision‑making, and production-grade implementation, while guiding teams and stakeholders from idea to scalable delivery.
  
  
You will act as the technical authority for GenAI, driving architectural excellence, evaluation strategies, and framework selection across enterprise use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end‑to‑end GenAI solution architecture, covering ideation, feasibility analysis, PoC execution, MVP design, and production‑ready implementation.
* Lead solution design and architecture workshops, translating complex business problems into scalable and secure GenAI architectures.
* Design, implement, and validate PoCs and MVPs to assess technical feasibility, architectural choices, cost-performance trade‑offs, and enterprise fit.
* Define and standardize enterprise GenAI reference architectures for chatbots, copilots, analytics assistants, and workflow automation use cases.
* Architect advanced RAG pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval methods, embedding optimization, reranking, and grounding techniques.
* Drive prompt engineering standards across solutions, including system prompt design, instruction tuning, reasoning control, and consistency guidelines.
* Define and govern prompt evaluation frameworks, covering correctness, faithfulness, hallucination reduction, determinism, latency, cost efficiency, and regression management.
* Lead architectural decisions around Chain‑of‑Thought (CoT), structured reasoning, and explainability strategies.
* Architect and review agentic AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, and custom orchestration layers, including multi‑agent coordination, tool usage, memory, routing, and fallback patterns.
* Own framework and technology evaluation, selecting appropriate GenAI frameworks based on scalability, reliability, observability, and enterprise constraints.
* Design scalable and secure FastAPI‑based service architectures to expose GenAI capabilities across enterprise platforms.
* Define enterprise security architecture, including JWT‑based authentication, authorization, data access controls, and LLM data protection.
* Lead AWS cloud architecture for GenAI workloads, ensuring scalability, reliability, cost optimization, and secure deployments.
* Architect and guide usage of DynamoDB, defining access patterns, performance optimization, and cost‑efficient designs.
* Define vector database architecture, embedding lifecycle management, similarity tuning, and retrieval performance optimization.
* Own LLM platform and model strategy, including evaluation and usage of AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI based on cost, latency, security, compliance, and roadmap alignment.
* Establish LLMOps practices, including prompt versioning, model versioning, evaluation pipelines, deployment strategies, monitoring, rollback mechanisms, and operational governance.
* Design observability and evaluation strategies for GenAI systems, covering logging, tracing, prompt metrics, retrieval metrics, agent behavior, and cost monitoring.
* Define and enforce guardrails and responsible AI practices to minimize hallucinations, prevent data leakage, and ensure compliant and safe GenAI behavior.
* Review and guide engineering teams through architecture reviews, PoC sign‑offs, MVP readiness, and production certification.
* Mentor senior engineers, architects, and managers on GenAI architecture, system design, and enterprise delivery best practices.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, providing clarity on feasibility, risks, timelines, and GenAI adoption strategy.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 14+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or AI platform design
* 5 years of GCP
* Strong expertise in Python Object‑Oriented Programming
* Deep hands‑on experience with RAG architectures, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, CoT, and guardrails
* Advanced Prompt Engineering and prompt evaluation methodologies
* Strong experience with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph)
* Expertise in FastAPI and API‑led enterprise architecture
* Strong AWS architecture experience, including DynamoDB
* Secure system design using JWT authentication
* Deep understanding of vector databases and embedding optimization
* Hands‑on experience with AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI
* Strong knowledge of LLMOps, including evaluation pipelines, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and governance of GenAI systems

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with enterprise chatbot, copilot, or analytics‑driven GenAI platforms
* Exposure to compliance‑heavy or regulated enterprise environments
* Thought leadership in GenAI architecture, governance, or AI platform strategy
* Experience in Insurance domain

What we are looking for
  
  

* Strong architectural ownership with a builder’s mindset
* Proven ability to convert ambiguous ideas into working PoCs and MVPs
* Deep understanding of GenAI reliability, evaluation, and operationalization (LLMOps)
* Ability to balance innovation, cost, performance, and enterprise risk
* Strong stakeholder communication and technical influence
* Vision to scale GenAI solutions from experimentation to enterprise platforms

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.

1c68a3f7.title: Program Manager, NA QC CO, RoW GSF & Now CO
1c68a3f7.description:
**Description**
Join our Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations team as a Program Manager I where you'll drive operational excellence for our quick commerce business in North America. In this high-impact role, you'll serve as the operational performance owner for the North America geographical region, identifying and eliminating defects that impact customer experience while collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize processes. You'll have the freedom to develop innovative solutions that reduce operational costs, eliminate quality issues, and enhance overall performance metrics.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of operations and strategic business improvements. You'll develop expertise in quick commerce business nuances specific to the North American market while exercising a high degree of ownership in identifying more efficient ways of working. Your analytical abilities will be crucial as you deep dive into operational data, identify root causes of performance issues, and implement effective solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction across North America.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own operational performance metrics for the North America region, conducting regular deep dives into data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement Identify and eliminate operational defects leading to negative customer experiences through root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures Partner with North American operations teams to understand daily performance challenges, diagnose bottlenecks, and develop strategies to reduce quality issues and business waste Represent Central Operations in business stakeholder meetings focused on North America performance, effectively communicating operational status, challenges, and proposed solutions Transform raw data into clear documentation, requirements, and actionable insights that drive process improvements across the North American organization
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
A day in the life Your day begins with an in-depth analysis of the previous day's operational defects in North America, using data to identify patterns and root causes. You'll collaborate with North American operations teams to understand the current day's performance status and potential challenges. Throughout the day, you'll brainstorm strategies to reduce operational costs and business waste specific to the NA market, represent Central Operations in business calls with North American stakeholders, and coordinate with the central CO team to provide necessary support where needed. You'll balance analytical work with cross-functional collaboration, all focused on improving customer experience in North America.
  
  
**About The Team**
About the team Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations (GSF CO) functions as the Command-and-Control Center for Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) operations in North America. We partner strategically with North American Operations, business teams, ACES, and S&OP teams, providing expertise in capacity management, defect reduction, holiday planning, contingency management, and automation of redundant workflows.
  
  
Our team operates with a progressive mental model: Centralize processes, Standardize across the North America geography, Automate to reduce manual effort, and ultimately Eliminate unnecessary processes through hands-off-the-wheel automation. This creates an innovative environment where you'll have significant impact on improving customer experiences across North America.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

b084a3d8.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
b084a3d8.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

**Work Timings:**
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday.
* Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
* L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L10+ Employees can apply

**Grade/Level: 12**
**Job Family Group**
Risk Management

Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

As an Applied AI Specialist: Cloud FullStack, you will design, build, and evolve cloud-native and hybrid applications that translate client requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions. This role involves collaborating with digital workers and intelligent agents to deliver solutions, applying an AI-First mindset and following established methodologies.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Solution Design: Designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.

Master's Degree

* Cloud Application Development: Exposure to designing and building cloud-native and hybrid applications that meet client requirements and are scalable, secure, and production-ready.

* CI/CD Pipeline Operation: Exposure to designing and operating CI/CD and GitOps pipelines with IaC and DevSecOps controls to ensure production readiness and cutover quality.
* Quality Assurance: Experience performing unit, module, and functional testing using testing agents and synthetic data to ensure quality and reliability.
* Hyperscaler Platforms: Exposure to hyperscalers such as AWS, Azure, and Red Hat OpenShift, and deployment models to architect resilient and cost-optimized full-stack and integration patterns.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Additional AI Tools: Exposure to other AI tools and technologies can be beneficial.
* Advanced Testing Methods: Familiarity with advanced testing methods and techniques is desirable.
* Emerging Technologies: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in cloud and AI can be advantageous.

f7508dde.title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
f7508dde.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**
*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*
**Tower**
Reward to Pay (R2P)
  
  
**Location**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)
  
  
**Reports to**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
  
  
**Scope**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings
  
  
**Grade**
**About The Hub**
Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
**KPI**
**Indicative target**
**Payroll accuracy**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors
  
  
**On-time payment**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date
  
  
**Off-cycle payments**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused
  
  
**Statutory compliance**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time
  
  
**Vendor SLA adherence**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs
  
  
**Cost per payslip**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline
  
  
**Audit outcome**
No high-rated findings
  
  
*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*
**Technical Skills**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**
Customer-centric leadership
  
  

* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
