**Grade**
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

****WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE****

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**Indicative target**
**Payroll accuracy**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors
  
  
**On-time payment**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date
  
  
**Off-cycle payments**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused
  
  
**Statutory compliance**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time
  
  
**Vendor SLA adherence**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs
  
  
**Cost per payslip**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline
  
  
**Audit outcome**
No high-rated findings

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

Customer-centric leadership

7f8d0d0e.description:
**Cloud Support Engineer**

**A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India cloud support team**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**About the Company**

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India cloud support team and has partnered with Flexiple to bring on cloud support engineers. You will be one of the first cloud specialists on the ground, shaping how the company supports customers running its product across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

**Role Overview**

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and deployment issues for customers, working closely with engineering to keep their environments stable and performant.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Troubleshooting & Support**

* Diagnose and resolve customer-reported issues across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments
* Investigate deployment failures, connectivity issues, and performance bottlenecks
* Reproduce issues in test environments and document root causes clearly

**Reliability & Product Partnership**

* Partner with engineering to escalate and close out complex cloud issues
* Contribute to runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal cloud documentation
* Share recurring customer patterns with product to influence the roadmap

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 2 to 6 years in cloud support, DevOps support, or site reliability roles
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Comfort with Linux administration and basic scripting in Python or Bash
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP associate level or higher)
* Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product

**What We Offer**

* A founding cloud-support seat with a high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company
* Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
* Direct exposure to engineering leadership and product decisions
* One application considered for this and future matched roles

**Hiring Process**

HR Screening → Technical Assessment → Hiring Manager Round → Culture Fit

3ccb22a1.description:
Job Title: SERVICE DELIVERY LEAD L2

City: Pune

State/Province: Maharashtra

Posting Start Date: 10/18/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to ensure excellent customer service delivery of all technology solutions and products to clients, through effective project management, service metrics tracking, budget management, issue resolution, optimal resource allocation, and maintenance of a skilled team of all delivery resources for the client.

**͏**
-----

**Do**

* **Oversee and manage service delivery by meeting all contractual/ SLA commitments**
  + Contract compliance & adherence
    - Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account
    - Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non-compliances are cited
    - Monitor and review all projects in the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines
    - Ensure that the service credits, performance incentives, penalty and penalty waivers are incorporated in the invoices
  + Delivery governance across the accounts/projects
    - Lead delivery teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and their thresholds for each project
    - Ensure that the project performance parameters stay green for all accounts
    - Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress, forecast performance and identify potential red flags
    - Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal/external stakeholders & senior leadership
    - Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition and performance
  + Technical and/or Operational Issue Resolution
    - Manage and resolve complex project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
    - Acts as an advisor to service delivery managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems on a daily basis
    - Acts as point of escalation for issues not resolvable by the service lines.
    - Escalate issues with financial implication on the account to Account Head and other senior stakeholders
    - Acts as an advisor to service line managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems

**͏**
-----

* Resource Allocation & Retention
  + Ensure effective transition from the client with the well documented and clear process understanding along with the right manpower requirements with requisite skill and training to undertake delivery
  + Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
  + Responsible for establishing, leading and maintaining a skilled team of all delivery resources for an account on a daily basis
  + Plan training batches to backfill client deliveries during crucial periods
  + Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
* Ensure Process Excellence
  + Partner with the assigned black belt for the account on regular basis to get feedback on account performance
  + Prioritize and drive initiatives for continuous improvement to improve top line revenue and bottom line margins
  + Present the business case for such initiatives to the clients to get their buy-in if required
  + Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional.
  + Conduct periodic meetings with clients and delivery teams daily status updates, service level requirement reviews, continuous improvement, change control and other informal meetings to share focus points, progress and successes.

**͏**
-----

* **Contribute to revenue and profitable growth by ensuring the agreed revenue targets are met and by identifying opportunities in the form of new and/or adjacent work in the assigned account**
  + Ensure excellent service delivery of all products and solutions to achieve approved margin targets on assigned accounts and is targeted to improve account profitability.
  + Regularly monitors and reports on financial health of the account and remedies any financial misses or anomalies
  + Contribute to the revenue growth of the account by supporting the Account Head through new opportunity identification for deployment of new technology, growth solutions and services within the existing account/client
  + Recognizes business needs and determines if our portfolio offering may be an appropriate solution
  + Qualify and prioritize new opportunities in the funnel in the form of adjacent work in existing accounts
  + Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned group of top tier client accounts with responsibility for retention and growth
  + Prepare implementation plans and ensure efficient client on-boarding; present content strategy and annual delivery plan
  + Partner with the process excellence team to incorporate and drive key Wipro initiatives and priorities in the account strategy such as Digital, Automation etc.
  + Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as required
  + Partner with the WFM, Hiring & HR team to ensure optimal resource allocation and maintenance of a ready skilled team of resources to avoid leakages and revenue loss

**͏**
-----

* **Develop, manage and leverage relationships in account to build customer centricity**
  + Identify key stakeholders/ decision makers in client organization and develop and strengthen relationships with them
  + Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
  + Drive and attend Steering Committee meetings or Client Review meetings to regularly review project dashboards, discuss and resolve escalation points and course correct as required for high customer satisfaction and better quality of experience
  + Act as client advocate and work with internal departments to ensure that client needs are understood and satisfied
  + Liaise between the customer and internal teams
* **Drive Delivery Transformation through automation and innovation focus**
  + Create and drive automation charter and related initiatives within account client (wherever applicable)
  + Drive deployment of automation led solutions and service improvements to deliver value added services to the clients
  + Build focus on and drive deployment of next generation hyper automation initiatives in coordination with Holmes team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
  Lead, develop and drive new ways of working (EOT, Digital, Agile etc.) and its capabilities within the account to improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters

6cc98cee.title: Operations Program Manager
6cc98cee.description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we face unique support problems resulting from our scale and the types of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational support and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to meet the growing needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. Our support experience draws on a deep understanding of our products, the financial industry, money movement, and our customers’ products and users. Building this experience requires us to invest significant resources in talented teams of Stripes.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We’re looking for dynamic and entrepreneurial leaders who will define our strategy for scaling the Core Payments team, improve operational workflows, and maintain a best-in-class Operations program. If you like hard problems, are analytical, are comfortable operating with ambiguity, and enjoy finding creative solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end product launches across multiple regions as an integrated program. Develop and maintain detailed launch plans that serve as the central point of coordination across globally distributed and highly cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product Management, go-to-market, cross-functional review, Support, and other key partner teams.
* Drive operational excellence across the product launch lifecycle by designing, improving, and implementing scalable processes that strengthen stakeholder coordination, clarify dependencies, maintain alignment, and support consistent execution across regions.
* Monitor and report on progress through biweekly status updates to senior leadership while maintaining transparent documentation throughout.
* Support cross-functional collaboration by identifying and documenting teams’ responsibilities for product launches, proactively communicating blockers, and providing transparent status updates and relevant documentation, such as product launch Gantt charts, program plans, and scope details.
* Define and improve operating rhythms that support efficient collaboration across teams. Manage operational cadences for product launches and business reviews, and track Stripe Objectives and Key Results (SOKRs).
* Establish scalable launch frameworks and operational structures to simplify execution, improve cross-functional alignment, and support efficient multi-region product rollouts.

**Minimum Requirements**

* More than 7 years of total work experience, including 4 to 5 years in program management, consulting, or a similar role within a high-growth technology company, with a strong focus on managing strategic product initiatives from conception through implementation.
* A proven track record in process and project management, including creating operational processes, leading product roadmap reviews, and designing scalable systems in fast-paced environments.
* Skill in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines to support the timely delivery of products and features.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and executing complex projects while building collaboration across diverse teams and functions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including high-level planning and ongoing communication to align project goals with operations.
* The ability to present ideas, product updates, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders, including executives, to build alignment and understanding of project objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in program management, consulting, or a similar role within payments or fintech.
* Familiarity with roadmap management tools and planning frameworks, and knowledge of how to apply them to manage projects effectively.
* The ability to understand the company’s strategic goals and align the product roadmap accordingly.
* Skill in helping stakeholders prioritize product features and initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and resource availability.
* A deep understanding of global markets and the ability to contextualize decisions and processes to account for regional nuances.
* Experience implementing process improvements and change-management strategies to scale operations effectively.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

924221b5.title: SERVICE DELIVERY MANAGER - TALENT ACQUISITION
924221b5.description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**
**Service Delivery Manager – Talent Acquisition**
*Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H)*
**Tower**
Recruit to Hire (R2H)
  
  
**Location**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)
  
  
**Reports to**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
  
  
**Scope**
Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding
  
  
**Grade**
As per BV grading framework
  
  
****ABOUT THE HUB****
Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.
  
  
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

****WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE****

* First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed.
* By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries.
* Within 12–18 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
**KPI**
**Indicative target**
**Time to offer / time to fill**
Reduced against the country baseline
  
  
**Offer TAT**
≥ 95%
  
  
**Candidate NPS**
≥ +40
  
  
**Hiring manager satisfaction**
≥ 4.3 / 5
  
  
**Day-one readiness**
≥ 98% of joiners fully set up
  
  
**Vendor SLA adherence**
≥ 95%
  
  
**Cost per hire**
Reduced against baseline
  
  
*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*
****TECHNICAL SKILLS****

* End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring.
* Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers.
* ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar).
* Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics.
* Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data.
* Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**
Customer-centric leadership
  
  

* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

****Essential****
**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations.
* Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model.
* Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

****Preferred****

* Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Experience deploying AI recruitment tools

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT.

09071c40.description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Job Purpose:**

Wipro is currently look for an experienced Program Manager to join our ranks. The Program Manager will be responsible for the overall technical transformation implementation at the client end.
  
 

͏

**Objectives of this role:**
- Strategize, implement, and maintain program initiatives that adhere to organizational and client objectives.
  
- Develop program assessment protocols for evaluation and improvement of Digital Transformation projects.
  
- Maintain organizational standards of satisfaction, quality, and performance.
  
- Oversee multiple project teams, ensuring program goals are reached.
  
- Manage budget and funding channels for maximum productivity.

͏

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders, including software engineers, data analysts, product managers, and operations teams, to design and improve end-to-end processes for operations.
  
- Lead process improvement initiatives by identifying areas for enhancement, conducting data analysis, and developing actionable recommendations as per the business and industry standards.
  
- Design and Drive large Transformation initiatives which may include automation, RPA, AI/GenAI, Chatbots, CX tools like agent assist, workflow orchestration, Quality management tools etc.
  
- Drive automation initiatives by leveraging technology and process optimization to streamline manual tasks and improve overall productivity.
  
- Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes related to banking operations and process optimization and apply this knowledge to improve business initiatives.
  
- Drive regular project meetings & ensure transformation initiatives are driven to completion.
  
- Manage discussions with required stakeholders for on various aspects of the program for timely follow up till closure.
  
- Performs Quality Control via reviews of the design created by Functional Consultant and Tech Architect
  
- Responsible for receiving the sign-off on the design, UAT and Hypercare from the customer 
  
- Establish working relationships and routinely interface with project sponsors, business stakeholders & technology partners.

͏

**Required skills and qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in an upper-management role, preferably in program management.
  
- Exceptional skills in leadership, time management, facilitation, and organization.
  
- Core experience in Digital Transformation in Telecom order management and front office processes with the tools/ solutions mentioned in role and responsibilities.
  
- Experience in managing stakeholders (internal and external).
  
- Outstanding knowledge of change management principles and performance evaluation processes.

͏

**Good to have skills and Experience:**

- PMP Certified is added advantage.
  
- Technical understanding of various Platform architecture and product features Genesys, SFDC, ServiceNow etc
  
- Current Technological landscape understanding and stays abreast of current technologies like AI/GenAI etc."

Mandatory Skills: Delivery Management
  
.

Experience: >10 YEARS

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
  
  
****Job Description****
**Engineering Team Leader, Industrial IoT & Digital Solutions**
Lead and develop an engineering team made up of junior and senior engineers in the development of Industrial IoT, Edge Computing, Cloud Connectivity, Data Analytics, and Digital Solutions for Husky products and customer operations. Focus on innovation, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives.

* Lead, manage, and develop the team, which includes but is not limited to coaching, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-training.
* Oversee the design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of Industrial IoT platforms, edge devices, cloud applications, and connected customer solutions.
* Ensure the team is effective in delivering scalable digital products and services that meet business and customer requirements and are aligned with product strategy and the Husky Operating Model.
* Plan and schedule development activities to ensure committed project milestones and release dates are achieved.
* Enforce Product Development Processes, cybersecurity standards, software quality requirements, architecture governance, and risk mitigation practices.
* Participate in and lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, design reviews, and executive updates to ensure implementation of high-quality digital solutions with stakeholder transparency.
* Influence and establish engineering standards, best practices, frameworks, and tools related to Industrial IoT, cloud computing, software engineering, and data platforms.
* Encourage team members to think, organize, innovate, and lead while providing career development opportunities and technical growth.
* Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration with Product Management, Software, Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, IT, Cybersecurity, and Customer Success teams.
* Drive the development and adoption of edge-to-cloud architectures, industrial communications, device management, remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data analytics solutions.
* Support customer deployments and operational excellence initiatives through digital solutions that improve machine performance, uptime, quality, and operational visibility.
* Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, DevOps practices, cybersecurity awareness, and data-driven decision making.

****Critical Capabilities And Qualifications****

* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation).
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop a high-performing technical team.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* System-level thinking at both product and enterprise levels.
* Strong understanding of Industrial IoT architectures, edge computing, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, system integration, and modern development methodologies.
* Experience with industrial communications and protocols including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and related technologies.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or equivalent.
* Experience with IoT device management, telemetry collection, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and monitoring solutions.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure software development practices, and industrial network security.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and agile development methodologies.
* Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility and adaptability while embracing changing priorities.
* Knowledge of Husky products, manufacturing processes, tools, standards, and technologies is an asset.
* Experience with Edge Computing, AI/ML applications, predictive analytics, digital twins, and Industry 4.0 initiatives is an asset.
* Experience facilitating cybersecurity, safety, or technology risk assessments is an asset.
* Relevant cloud, cybersecurity, or industrial automation certifications are considered an asset.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

****Experience****

* 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in Industrial IoT, software development, industrial automation, connected products, or digital solutions.
* Proven leadership experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, or Industrial IoT solutions from concept through deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing, automation, machinery, packaging, injection molding, or industrial technology industries is an asset.
* Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across multiple functional disciplines is an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

881bf3e5.title: Salesforce Senior Technical Architect (CTA Aspirants)
881bf3e5.description:
**Description**
The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 14+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

f3c8652f.description:
**Summary**
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Passion works here, our community is made up of every kind of individual: artists and designers, engineers and scientists, problem solvers and doers. Together we build things and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined - and now can’t imagine living without. So if you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your dream job. Just be ready to dream big!
  
  
We invite you to join Apple's growing Engineering Program Management (EPM) group. Our team is looking for a hard-working, detail-oriented, and motivated EPM to drive Apple’s product development process from prototype to mass production. We value folks who take ownership and drive for product excellence while demonstrating great teamwork skills. As an iPhone System EPM, you will work with a cross-functional team of skilled electrical and mechanical engineers. Using your solid technical foundation to recognize, assess and communicate issues and risks across key hardware sub-systems that are an integral part of iPhone system product development. We are looking for a high-energy in-region EPM to lead system product development and support build events at the Contract Manufacturer.
  
  
**Description**

* In this role, you will lead multidisciplinary engineering initiatives, align cross-functional teams, and facilitate seamless execution across the entire hardware lifecycle:
* Lead cross-functional engineering teams through prototype build milestones and New Product Introduction (NPI) phases, establishing daily build plans and operational direction.
* Develop, maintain, and track complex engineering hardware schedules, critical path milestones, and project budgets.
* Identify, prioritize and mitigate technical, operational, and supply risks across key electrical and mechanical sub-systems.
* Summarize critical issue updates into clear status overviews for project teams and leadership.
* Establish structure and clear priorities in dynamic, evolving engineering environments while navigating ambiguity to keep development on schedule.
* Act as the point of contact with Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and Original Equipment/Design - Manufacturers (OEMs/ODMs) to coordinate engineering line activities, component availability, and build execution.
* Domestic and international travel (up to 35%) to support hardware build events, vendor integrations, and on-site engineering activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* B.Tech / BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field required
* Proactive, self motivated, action oriented, go-getter, detail oriented
* Demonstrated international experience, with a proven track record of directly collaborating with overseas suppliers, Contract Manufacturers (CMs), or global engineering & operations partners
* Minimum 4-7 years of industry experience in hardware engineering program management or technical system development
* Solid technical understanding of hardware development lifecycles, circuit design, PCB/PCBA integration, or system architecture
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
* Ability to filter and distill complex technical data for executive decision-makers, rapidly understand new situations, and adapt to changes
* Self-motivated and proactive with demonstrated creative and critical thinking abilities
* Ability to travel — domestic & international (up to 30%)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Experience managing the development lifecycle of portable consumer electronics or tightly integrated electro-mechanical products.
* Technical background or familiarity with Mechatronics, bridging mechanical and electrical system interactions.
* Formal project or program management experience (e.g., PMP certification) managing cross-functional technical work streams.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

e7edab8b.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an ERPNext Pre-Sales Executive who can understand customer business requirements and prepare accurate, professional proposals and quotations based on ERPNext functionalities and customization requirements.

The candidate will analyse customer requirements, identify suitable standard ERPNext features, distinguish between configuration and customization, coordinate with developers to validate technical feasibility and effort estimates, and prepare proposals with clearly defined scope, deliverables, timelines, and costs.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand customer business requirements through phone calls, emails, online meetings, and requirement documents.
* Analyse customer workflows and map them to ERPNext modules and standard functionalities.
* Understand ERPNext modules such as Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Stock, CRM, HRMS, Manufacturing, and other relevant modules.
* Identify requirements that can be fulfilled through standard features, configuration, customization, custom reports, or third-party integrations.
* Document functional requirements and identify gaps between standard ERPNext functionality and customer expectations.
* Coordinate with ERPNext functional consultants and developers to confirm technical feasibility and estimate customization efforts.
* Prepare professional ERPNext implementation proposals, quotations, and Statements of Work (SOW).
* Clearly define project scope, modules, deliverables, customizations, integrations, timelines, assumptions, and exclusions.
* Prepare preliminary implementation cost estimates in coordination with the technical and project teams.
* Revise proposals based on customer feedback and internal discussions.
* Maintain proper documentation of requirements, proposals, quotations, and revisions.
* Ensure a clear handover of approved project scope to the implementation team.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of ERPNext and its business modules.
* Understanding of business workflows and software implementation processes.
* Ability to distinguish standard ERPNext features from configuration and customization requirements.
* Good analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and professional proposal preparation.
* Ability to coordinate with sales, functional, and development teams.
* Attention to detail when defining project scope, deliverables, and costs.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in ERPNext pre-sales, functional consulting, business analysis, or software implementation.
* Familiarity with Frappe Framework and ERPNext customization concepts.
* Experience preparing software proposals, quotations, and implementation estimates.
* Understanding of accounting, inventory, sales, purchase, CRM, and other business processes.

Performance Indicators

* Accuracy of customer requirement documentation.
* Quality and turnaround time of proposals and quotations.
* Correct identification of standard ERPNext features and customization requirements.
* Accuracy of preliminary project estimates.
* Reduction in scope-related misunderstandings during implementation.
* Timely coordination and handover to the implementation team.

Job Conditions

* 100% office-based position.
* No field sales, outdoor marketing, or routine customer-site visits.
* Customer communication through phone, email, and online meetings.
* Primary focus on ERPNext requirement analysis, solution mapping, customization assessment, proposal preparation, and quotation preparation.

**Ideal Candidate:** Someone who can understand customer requirements, map them to ERPNext, identify customization needs, coordinate with technical teams, and prepare a clear and commercially accurate proposal before the project is committed.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹34,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

5067fdac.description:
About AgentCallBack

AgentCallBack provides enterprise Voice AI agents that manage inbound and outbound customer conversations at scale. Our multilingual AI agents operate 24/7, handle natural interruptions, remember prior interactions, transfer calls to human agents and integrate with CRM, ERP, contact-centre and telephony platforms.

We serve customers across healthcare, insurance, financial services, hospitality, retail, property management and other service-based industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a technically strong and customer-focused Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise Voice AI solutions.

You will work closely with customers, sales, product and engineering teams to understand business requirements, design solution architecture, manage integrations and guide implementations from discovery through production deployment.

The ideal candidate understands enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, telephony and conversational AI, and can translate complex technical concepts into clear business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers and document business, integration, security and operational requirements.
* Design end-to-end Voice AI solutions covering telephony, conversation workflows, integrations, data flows, security and human-agent transfers.
* Create solution architecture diagrams, integration specifications, call flows and implementation plans.
* Design integrations with CRM and ERP platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards and GoHighLevel.
* Integrate AgentCallBack with contact-centre and telephony platforms such as Genesys Cloud, 3CX, Yeastar, SIP trunks and PBX systems.
* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication frameworks, data files and middleware platforms.
* Convert customer use cases into structured AI conversation flows, including escalation rules, exception handling and compliance requirements.
* Support demonstrations, proposals, technical presentations and responses to RFPs.
* Define the scope, success criteria and technical requirements for pilots and proofs of concept.
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to configure, test and deploy customer solutions.
* Lead user acceptance testing, production readiness reviews and technical handover.
* Diagnose integration, call-quality, latency and workflow issues during implementation.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, reliability and data privacy.
* Identify reusable solution patterns and contribute to implementation templates and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to customers, implementation partners and internal teams.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise integration, technical consulting or implementation.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication and enterprise data integration.
* Experience integrating CRM, ERP, contact-centre or customer-service applications.
* Working knowledge of SIP, VoIP, PBX systems, call routing and contact-centre technology.
* Experience designing cloud-based, scalable and secure enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, process flows, functional specifications and integration documents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, speech recognition or generative AI solutions.
* Knowledge of large language models, prompt design, knowledge bases and conversational workflow development.
* Experience with platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Genesys Cloud, 3CX or GoHighLevel.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of call recording, consent, Do Not Call requirements and data-protection regulations.
* Experience working with customers across multiple countries, languages and industries.
* Previous experience in a SaaS company, systems integrator or enterprise software consulting environment.

Key Competencies

* Customer-focused problem solving
* Solution and systems thinking
* Strong technical ownership
* Clear communication and presentation
* Attention to detail
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by:

* Quality and scalability of proposed solutions
* Speed and effectiveness of customer implementations
* Successful completion of pilots and production deployments
* Integration reliability and call-flow accuracy
* Customer satisfaction and adoption
* Clear documentation and effective knowledge transfer

Why Join AgentCallBack?

* Work on practical enterprise applications of Voice AI.
* Design solutions across telephony, AI, CRM and ERP technologies.
* Work directly with global customers and senior decision-makers.
* Influence product capabilities and implementation standards.
* Join a growing Singapore-based technology company serving international markets.

**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Validation**

* Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms.
* Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms.
* Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios.
* Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices.

**Integration & Performance Testing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans.
* Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads.
* Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers.

**Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions.
* Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments.
* Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers.
* Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation.
* Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation.
* Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures.
* Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently.
* Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms.
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments.
* Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures.
* Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development.

**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

d5bf7c12.title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
d5bf7c12.description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.
