2b28b3d5.title: AI Architect
2b28b3d5.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
**AI Architect**
to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
  
  
You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
  
  
It is deliberately a
**hands-on architect**
role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.
  
  
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI
  
  
Shape demand and executive conviction
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.
* Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins → platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have
  
  

* Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and consulting experience. This position requires a leader who can effectively bridge business objectives and technology capabilities while building scalable solutions, driving operational excellence, and establishing Judge India as a trusted technology partner in consulting, managed services, and digital transformation initiatives.

* Define and execute the overall technology vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with organizational growth objectives.
* Lead enterprise technology transformation initiatives across application development, cloud modernization, AI/ML adoption, automation, and digital platforms.
* Establish technology standards, architecture frameworks, and governance models across delivery and consulting functions.
* Build and lead high-performing teams across engineering, architecture, consulting, product development, AI/ML, and managed services.
* Act as the organization's senior technology advisor for leadership teams, clients, partners, and key stakeholders.
* Drive innovation initiatives and evaluate emerging technologies to create competitive business advantages.

**IT Consulting & Digital Transformation**

* Lead technology consulting engagements for enterprise and public-sector customers.
* Partner with business leaders to understand customer challenges and translate them into technology-enabled solutions.
* Guide customers through digital transformation journeys, including cloud adoption, modernization programs, platform engineering, cybersecurity improvements, AI solutions, and operational optimization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to CXOs, technology leaders, and government stakeholders.
* Assist clients in developing technology roadmaps, transformation strategies, and future-state architectures.

**Solutioning, Presales & Strategic Bids**

* Own end-to-end solutioning for large consulting, managed services, and technology transformation opportunities.
* Lead technical strategy and architecture for large-scale RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and government tenders.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, finance, and operations teams to build winning proposals.
* Develop innovative and competitive solutions across managed services, application services, cloud operations, AI services, workforce solutions, and digital platforms.

* Develop transformation roadmaps that help clients improve performance, reduce costs, and enhance business outcomes.

* Lead innovation initiatives focused on AI-driven platforms, intelligent automation, analytics, and next-generation digital solutions.

**Delivery Excellence & Governance**

* Ensure successful delivery of complex technology programs across enterprise and government customers.
* Define and monitor delivery KPIs, quality metrics, project governance structures, and performance frameworks.

**Talent Development & Organizational Growth**

* Build and mentor technology leaders, architects, consulting managers, engineering managers, and delivery leaders.
* Drive workforce planning, capability development, succession planning, and leadership growth initiatives.
* Establish centres of excellence across emerging technologies, architecture, cloud, AI/ML, cybersecurity, and digital transformation.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer-centricity.

You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**

* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions

* Experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders
* Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  
  
You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You've Accomplished**

* You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.
* You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.
* You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.
* You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologies

**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

1199f604.title: Solution Architect - Power Platform
1199f604.description:
**Job Description**
As a Solution Architect specializing in Microsoft Power Platform, you will design and deliver innovative business solutions by leveraging tools such as Copilot Studio, Power Apps, and Power Automate. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will define end-to-end solution architecture, enforce governance policies, and mentor development teams. Your expertise will drive digital transformation, enhance user experience, and optimize automation within the organization.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Define and manage the end-to-end solution architecture for Power Platform implementations.
* Design and govern Power Platform infrastructure, including environment setup and licensing.
* Establish and enhance governance policies and best practices for Power Platform usage.
* Create and validate technical documentation, solution blueprints, and guides.
* Lead and mentor development teams on Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio.
* Review and validate functional and technical designs, ensuring alignment with best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing architectural fixes and performance tuning.
* Drive roadmap planning for the Power Platform, coordinating with Microsoft’s product updates.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* 12+ years of experience in enterprise IT solution design and development, including at least 4+ years in Power Platform/low-code architecture roles
* Deep expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages
* Strong hands-on experience in architecture of scalable solutions with a focus on performance and security
* Extensive experience with PowerShell, C#, or other programming languages for solution development
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including the ability to present to senior management

**Nice-To-Have:**

* Experience with Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 agents
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies and Azure DevOps
* Familiarity with other Microsoft 365 applications like MS Teams and SharePoint
* Experience in deploying large-scale technical solutions
* Passion for user experience, AI, and collaboration tools

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

99ca8d7e.title: Senior Architect
99ca8d7e.description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Solution Architect – Java
  
  
Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**
**Job ID: 50320**
**Profile Summary:**
Solution Architect with experience in building enterprise grade web applications. Candidates should be familiar with “The Twelve Factor App”, continuous delivery concepts and “Cloud Native Applications”.
  
  
**About HID Global**
HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**

* Define end-to-end architecture for cloud-native and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Produce and maintain solution architecture documents, component diagrams, data flows, integration designs, and architecture decision records.
* Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, performance, availability, observability, compliance, and cost requirements.
* Translate business requirements into secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solution designs.
* Design AI solutions using Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, semantic search, vector databases, and agentic workflows.
* Evaluate cloud services, AI models, platforms, frameworks, and integration approaches, documenting key decisions and trade-offs.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction to engineering, cloud, security, data, and product teams.
* Establish reusable architecture patterns, standards, guardrails, and best practices for cloud and responsible AI adoption

****Technical Requirements:****

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering or application delivery, including significant experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Architect.
* Strong experience designing secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available cloud-native applications, preferably on AWS.
* Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, including Large Language Models, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and AI agents.
* Experience defining solution architectures for microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, enterprise integrations, and SaaS applications.
* Good working knowledge of Java and Python, with the ability to review technical designs and guide engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, data privacy, observability, performance, and cost optimisation.
* Experience creating architecture diagrams, solution design documents, technology evaluations, and architecture decision records.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Experience and/or Education Qualification:**

* Undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required, with graduate degree preferred
* 12+ years of overall experience in Application/Solution Development domain
* Experience building Cloud Native Applications
* Expert hands-on proficiency in Developing Applications using one or more technology stacks
* Strong hands-on understanding of scalability, security, high availability and operational requirements
* Experience with full product lifecycle
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

****Why apply?****

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

9e9e3ded.title: Tech S and T-Enterprise Architect - Commercial Sector-Architecture-Senior manager-GDSF04
9e9e3ded.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role: Enterprise Architect – Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST)**
**Experience: 15+ Years**
**Description**
A senior enterprise architecture leadership role responsible for defining technology strategy, driving enterprise-wide modernization and transformation initiatives, and shaping future-state architectures across large, complex organizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong blend of
**enterprise architecture, deep technical architecture credibility, consulting mindset, and stakeholder leadership**
. The Enterprise Architect is expected to engage senior business and technology leaders while providing architectural direction for large-scale, cloud-native and distributed systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead enterprise architecture workstreams for transformation, modernization, and assessment initiatives.
* Design and lead the development of large-scale cloud and custom-built solutions, leveraging modern architecture patterns such as microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and modernization roadmaps, including application portfolio rationalization.
* Engage with business stakeholders, architects, delivery teams, and executive governance forums to guide end-to-end solution delivery, architecture decisions, and thought leadership.
* Support presales activities including solution shaping, estimation, proposals, client workshops, and executive presentations.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields.

**Enterprise Architecture Expertise**

* 15+ years of IT experience with at least 6+ years in Enterprise Architecture or equivalent senior architecture leadership roles.
* Proven experience defining enterprise target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and architecture governance models.
* Strong experience conducting enterprise assessments and application portfolio rationalization initiatives.
* Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman, or equivalent.

**Technical Depth**

* Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to architect and guide delivery of large-scale, complex enterprise systems.
* Cloud Native and Microservices based solutions

+ Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, API-led integration, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures.
+ Experience designing systems for scalability, resilience, security, high availability, and performance.
+ Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data platforms, containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, and observability.
+ Experience working across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid/multi-cloud environments.
+ Provide full stack architecture leadership, designing solutions across front end, back end, integration, data, and cloud layers, including modern web-based front end technologies such as React or Angular.

* Architecture experience with AI based solutions

+ Architecture-level understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
+ Ability to define high-level GenAI solution architectures involving enterprise knowledge bases, document search, summarization, workflow automation, and conversational interfaces.
+ Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, guardrails, human oversight, and regulatory considerations.

**Leadership & Consulting Skills**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead architecture teams, and steer complex transformation programs.
* Strong communication, consulting, and presentation skills, including experience delivering thought leadership.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Architecture and cloud certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP certifications or similar.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

is head hunting for its client for

This is a Hybrid Opportunity to be based at Pune .

**Job Title: Delivery Lead for Banking Domain**

Pune (hybrid; at least 3 days a week in office)

15+ years in IT services, with the last 5 years spent leading delivery for a bank

: 50–150 people

• Maintain information security, data privacy and audit readiness.

• Manage contract compliance and delivery risk.

• Experience leading teams of 50+ and managing an account or programme.

• Hands-on experience delivering for clients in the US.

• Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum, SAFe, DevOps and Waterfall.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure.

• Working knowledge of APIs and microservices, data and analytics, and test automation.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

• Understanding of US market practices such as T+1 settlement, DTCC processes, and payments (ACH, Fedwire, SWIFT).

d887eb12.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

a7031eed.title: Associate Technical Program Manager
a7031eed.description:
**Associate Technical Program Manager**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Full-time, On-site | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 1-5 years | Reports to: Founder & CEO | Joining: Immediate or early joining preferred

**ABOUT SVECTOR**

SVECTOR builds enterprise software and decision-intelligence systems for complex industries and high-stakes business environments. Our work spans enterprise AI, healthcare, industrial intelligence, talent intelligence and financial intelligence.

Engineering, product, research, customer requirements and business execution are closely connected here, and this role sits at the center of that.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This role combines Technical Program Management with Chief of Staff responsibilities, working directly with the Founder & CEO. It is designed for early-career professionals with 1-5 years of experience who want heavy responsibility early. It is not a senior or leadership position, and we will not consider applicants with significantly more experience than this range. It is a six-day, on-site role in Ahmedabad, not remote or hybrid. It is not an admin, calendar or task-tracking job, and "I passed it on" does not count as finished work. If you are ready to earn responsibility through real work, read on.

THE ROLE

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO on important product, technology, customer and business initiatives, and with engineering, product and business teams to get them done. On one initiative you may be working with engineers to resolve an API integration. On another you may be preparing a customer requirements brief, evaluating an unfamiliar technology, coordinating a product demo or driving a business priority to completion.

The job in one line: understand the problem, decide what needs to happen, bring the right people and information together, and make sure the intended result is delivered and verified.

You do not need prior experience with these titles. You do need technical curiosity, strong analytical ability, reliable execution and the willingness to own difficult work. We do not want someone who only tracks tasks, schedules meetings or forwards instructions. We want someone who understands the substance and owns the outcome.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Technical Program Execution

- Turn broad priorities into clear workstreams with owners, milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria

- Coordinate engineers, product contributors and business stakeholders

- Track real progress, not just reported task status

- Investigate blockers and find out why work is delayed or incomplete

- Raise risks before deadlines are missed and propose practical recovery plans

- Verify that delivered work meets the original requirement

A task marked done is not a completed program. The outcome has to be verified.

Product and Software Understanding

- Understand user journeys and product workflows, and test our software

- Write PRDs, BRDs, functional requirements and acceptance criteria

- Read API documentation, JSON structures and integration specifications

- Understand authentication, data flows and external service dependencies

- Reproduce issues and document expected versus actual behaviour

- Convert customer feedback into actionable requirements

- Support demos, pilots and implementation work

You are not expected to replace an engineer or decide architecture. You are expected to understand the technology well enough to ask meaningful questions and spot missing information. Blind coordination is not enough.

Ownership and Accountability

For every assignment, establish the problem, the expected outcome, what is known and unknown, who must contribute, what blocks progress, the deadline, which decisions need approval and how completion will be verified.

"I sent the message", "I followed up" and "I completed my part" are not proof of completion. If a stakeholder does not respond, decide the next action. If a technical issue is unresolved, investigate the dependency and find a path forward. If a deadline is at risk, say so early. If you make a mistake, report it accurately and fix it.

Research and Decision Support

- Research enterprise customers, software products, competitors, AI systems, vendors and industries

- Examine primary sources, question assumptions and spot inconsistencies

- Clearly separate verified facts, estimates, interpretation and open questions

- Deliver findings, implications and recommendations, not long summaries

Customer and Business Initiatives

- Research prospective customers and prepare briefs for important conversations

- Document customer requirements and support proof-of-concept work

- Prepare structured technical and commercial material

- Make sure every customer conversation ends with clear next actions and owners

Chief of Staff Responsibilities

- Turn the Founder & CEO's priorities into plans with owners and deadlines

- Prepare decision briefs, executive summaries and program reviews that can be used without rewriting

- Keep accurate records of commitments, decisions, owners and deadlines across teams

- Surface cross-functional conflicts, clarify decision rights and escalate what needs leadership input

- Make sure decisions reach the right people accurately and follow up until they are carried out

- Maintain continuity when priorities change

- Support selected hiring research, interview preparation and onboarding

- Handle confidential company, customer and personnel information with strict discretion

Coordination does not mean authority over other functions. You will respect specialist expertise and decision rights, and recognise when a decision belongs to leadership. Access to leadership does not create authority to make personnel, contractual or commercial commitments.

HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK

AI-native: You should already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, analysis, requirements and documentation. You are responsible for checking the output and must be able to explain the work without the tool. Confidential information must never go into unauthorised external tools.

Communication: Your writing must be clear, accurate and concise. You should be able to explain a technical problem to a business stakeholder and a business requirement to an engineer. When you raise an issue, state what happened, what is verified, why it matters, the options, your recommendation and the decision needed.

Judgment: We expect reliability, honest reporting of problems and mistakes, independent problem-solving before escalating, and well-reasoned disagreement. Once a decision is made, you help execute it professionally.

WHO YOU ARE

Experience: 1-5 years in a relevant role such as Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Operations, Software Engineer interested in product and business execution, Implementation Engineer or Analyst, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, Technical Presales or Technical Customer Success. Experience supporting a founder or CEO is not required.

Education: A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science or a closely related technical field is preferred. Others may be considered if they show strong technical understanding through professional work.

Essential skills

- Technical fluency in software, APIs, integrations and data flows

- Product understanding and the ability to interpret requirements and workflows

- Ability to take work from problem definition to verified completion

- Strong reasoning, research discipline and attention to evidence

- Fast learning in unfamiliar products and industries

- Clear professional writing and verbal communication

- Reliable follow-through, discretion and accountability

Good to have

- REST APIs, JSON and SQL

- PRD and BRD writing

- Jira, Linear, Notion or similar tools

- Software testing or technical implementation

- SaaS or AI-powered products

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first three months you should be progressing toward:

- Understanding product workflows and technical dependencies independently

- Turning ambiguous requirements into useful execution plans

- Investigating technical issues instead of simply forwarding them

- Producing accurate requirements, research and decision briefs

- Separating actual completion from reported progress

- Reducing the effort leadership spends tracking your work

Early assignments are scoped to your experience, and responsibility grows as you prove your capability. Performance is judged on real work, feedback and verified outcomes, not activity.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Not remote or hybrid. Immediate or early joining is preferred. If you are currently employed, give your accurate notice period and a realistic joining date.

WHY SVECTOR

- Work directly with the Founder & CEO

- Real exposure to building and running enterprise software and AI products

- Work that connects engineering, product, customers, research and business decisions

- Growing responsibility as your capability develops

We value people who want to build strong technical and commercial judgment through real work, not just collect a more impressive title.

HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Your application must include a short written description of one technical or business initiative you personally helped take from problem definition to completion. Cover:

- The original problem

- What you personally owned

- The technical or business challenges that came up

- What you did

- The result and how you verified it

Applications without this response will not be reviewed. Generic or AI-generated answers that you cannot explain in detail will be exposed in the interview.

Candidates with similar skills or experiences may be considered and training may be offered where needed. Applicants will be reviewed for this position as well as similar roles with varying skill requirements and/or years of experience.

1e856ce1.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER**

**THE ROLE:**

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production.

**THE PERSON:**

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug.
* Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations.
* Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment.
* Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines.
* Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures.
* Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149.x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features.
* Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives.
* Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization.
* Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

ebb35399.title: Technical Architect - AWS
ebb35399.description:
**About Us**
At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect & Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level cloud architecture and hands-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core.
  
  
The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third-party fleet compliance ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross-platform ecosystem integration:
  
  
Cloud Architecture & Strategy
  
  

* Design & Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high-velocity streaming data environments.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments.
* CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time-to-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates.
* Security & Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role-based access control.

Backend Software Engineering
  
  

* Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node.js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Data Processing & AI: Program state-of-the-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e.g., speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking).
* Database & Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases.
* Testing & Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms.

Multi-Platform Ecosystem Integration
  
  

* Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows.
* Telematics & Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third-party systems including:

+ Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data.
+ Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A&I, and DataQs datasets).
+ Risk & Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments.

* Salesforce & MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end-to-end event-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce.

**Requirements**
What We're Looking For
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:

+ Minimum of 5–7 years of proven hands-on software development experience writing clean production code.
+ Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi-system integration topographies.

* AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Developer – Associate).
* Technical Proficiency:

+ Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node.js.
+ AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs).
+ Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures.
+ Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment.

* Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

**Company Profile:**

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.

**Job Title: SAP Basis Consultant**

**Position: Senior Software Engineer**

**Experience: 5 -10 Years**

**Category: Software Development/ Engineering**

**Shift: General**

**Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai**

**Position ID:**

**Employment Type: Full Time**

**Education Qualification**: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.

**Position Description:**

We are seeking an experienced **SAP Senior Consultant – SAP Basis & SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)** with expertise in **SAP Cloud ALM** to design, implement, administer, and optimize SAP landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP Basis administration, SAP BTP services, cloud integration, system monitoring, and lifecycle management. You will work closely with functional, technical, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing SAP environments.

**Responsibilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support SAP Basis landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain SAP systems including S/4HANA, ECC, and NetWeaver.
* Implement and manage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services and subaccounts.
* Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, implementation, operations, and integration scenarios.
* Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Manage transport management, client administration, and system refresh activities.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams for SAP deployments, upgrades, and migrations.
* Ensure system availability, security, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance with SAP best practices.
* Support SAP integration with cloud and third-party applications.
* Prepare technical documentation and participate in production support and on-call activities as required.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in SAP Basis Administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP).
* Experience implementing and administering SAP Cloud ALM.
* Expertise in SAP system installation, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, and migrations.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, NetWeaver, and HANA Database administration.
* Strong knowledge of transport management, client administration, and system monitoring.
* Experience with SAP security concepts, user administration, and authorizations.
* Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and database administration.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting SAP workloads.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with SAP Solution Manager.
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud Connector.
* Experience with automation and scripting using Shell, Python, or PowerShell.
* SAP Basis, SAP BTP, or SAP Cloud ALM certifications.
* Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

**Life at CGI**:

It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons

Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

401ba4c7.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
401ba4c7.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.

F9 Infotech is a leading cloud consulting and managed services provider, helping enterprises accelerate their cloud transformation journeys. We specialize in cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure solutions, and managed services across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Nutanix environments.

We are looking for a
**Cloud Migration Engineer**
with hands-on experience in migrating enterprise workloads to AWS, Azure, or Nutanix NC2.

**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

* Develop business cases, executive dashboards, technology roadmaps, and solution recommendations for client engagements.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, DevOps, and Platform teams to align technology initiatives with enterprise governance and operational objectives.
* Support pre-sales opportunities, solutioning workshops, RFP responses, technical proposals, and strategic consulting engagements.

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Application Development, API Engineering, Full Stack Development, and Technology Delivery.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, architecture programs, and large-scale cloud transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture principles including microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Proven expertise in API strategy, API governance, integration architecture, and enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience leading AI/ML and Generative AI solution development and enterprise adoption programs.

* Master’s degree preferred.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Proven expertise in AI/ML technologies including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and MLOps.
* Strong competency in developing solutions using LLMs, RAG Architectures, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, and Vector Databases.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, Platform Engineering, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Redis, Pinecone, ChromaDB, and FAISS.

026aa4b5.title: Technical Account Manager
026aa4b5.description:
